literature.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 截至2026年3月,全球144个国家共报告了181,164例确诊病例和492例死亡病例。免疫功能低下者、HIV感染者、孕妇和儿童更容易出现严重疾病和并发症。猴痘(暴发)的前所未有的地理扩散凸显了在疾病流行病学、预防和控制方面的知识空白。 [10.1186/s41182-026-01048-9]
病毒检测结果为阴性,伤口培养确认存在携带额外毒力基因的Panton-Valentine溶白细胞素阳性金黄色葡萄球菌。 [10.1097/inf.0000000000005399]
该研究发现,天花病毒疫苗接种诱导的CD8+ T细胞免疫可交叉识别猴痘病毒(MPXV)表位M15和M17,并且在疫苗接种感染后仍可检测超过四十年,如53至75岁个体所示。 [10.64898/2026.09.08.750003]

{"field_kind": "abstract","text": "摘要 背景 世界卫生组织建议将疫苗接种作为控制猴痘 暴发在全球的重要公共卫生干预措施。然而,加纳对接受猴痘 疫苗的意愿及其影响因素了解尚不充分。本研究利用5C 疫苗接种模型,评估了加纳人对接受猴痘 疫苗的意愿及其相关因素。方法 这是一项于2025年7月至10月期间在加纳进行的全国性横断面在线调查。本研究遵循了横断面研究STROBE声明的要求进行和报告。问卷基于疫苗接种的五个心理先决条件(信心、自满、约束、计算和集体责任)以及WHO关于猴痘的常见问题制定和修改。使用Stata 17版本进行了描述性统计、卡方检验和多元线性回归分析。结果 本研究共纳入1670名受访者,其中18-22岁年龄组占比最高(761人,45.61%),女性占主导地位(1296人,77.60%)。大多数受访者表示愿意接种疫苗(1006人,60.24%)。疫苗的信心(p ≤ 0.001)、自满(p ≤ 0.001)和计算(p = 0.003)与接受猴痘 疫苗的意愿显著相关。23-27岁年龄组接受猴痘 疫苗的意愿显著更高(aOR = 1.41;95% CI:1.11–1.80;p = 0.005)。博诺地区(aOR = 2.67;95% CI:1.32–5.42;p = 0.007)、东北地区(aOR = 2.29;95% CI:1.11–4.76;p = 0.026)和萨瓦纳地区(aOR = 1.91;95% CI:1.01–3.28;p = 0.048)的受访者接受猴痘 疫苗的意愿显著更高。高疫苗信心(aOR = 1.75;95% CI:1.40–2.20;p ≤ 0.001)和计算(aOR = 1.73;95% CI:1.35–2.06;p ≤ 0.001)也与。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10694398/v1]
所有孕妇均未出现严重并发症。这三名男性新生儿在出生后三周内均出现发热和广泛分布的水疱-脓疱性皮疹。两名新生儿的循环阈值较低,与高病毒DNA载量一致。两名婴儿完全康复,而另一名因经济原因过早出院而死亡。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10693920/v1]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: As of March 2026, 181,164 confirmed cases and 492 deaths had been reported across 144 countries globally. Immunocompromised individuals, people living with HIV, pregnant women, and children are at increased risk of severe disease and complications. [10.1186/s41182-026-01048-9]

Viral testing was negative, and wound culture confirmed the presence of Panton-Valentine leucocidin-positive Staphylococcus aureus, which carried additional virulence genes. [10.1097/inf.0000000000005399]

The study found that smallpox vaccination induces CD8+ T-cell immunity that cross-recognizes MPXV epitopes M15 and M17 and remains detectable for more than four decades after vaccination, as shown in individuals aged 53–75. [10.64898/2026.09.08.750003]

Most of the respondents indicated their willingness to take the mpox vaccine (1006, 60.24%). Vaccine confidence (p ≤ 0.001), complacency (p ≤ 0.001), and calculation (p = 0.003) were significantly associated with the willingness to receive mpox vaccine. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10694398/v1]

All mothers recovered without major complications. All three male neonates presented within the first three weeks of life with fever and disseminated vesiculopustular eruptions. Two neonates had low cycle threshold values, consistent with a high viral DNA burden. [10.21203/rs.3.rs-10693920/v1]

news.headline_zh: 猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期猴痘病毒（Mpox病毒）新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 卫生部门确认卡拉奇出现另一例猴痘感染,使信德省今年的累计确诊病例达到43例。患者因出现皮疹被送往信德传染病医院,经PCR检测确认感染。 [news-aa10ced59f5b434e]
一项全球倡议启动,旨在改善猴痘 疫苗的获取并确保暴发期间的公平分配。该倡议基于世界卫生组织(WHO)及其合作伙伴的工作,并涉及国际协调小组(ICG)。 [news-ac6c129fae712770]
2026年台湾报告了30例猴痘确诊病例,包括新增的两例感染,其中输入性病例较前一年翻倍,大多数病例与未采取保护措施的性接触有关,如疾病管制署(CDC)所述。 [news-232f8a513a7ed92b]
猴痘确诊病例较去年增加,报告了两例新病例,包括一例本地病例和一例输入病例。 [news-fab0582cb6e73262]
在研究该病毒对小鼠模型的影响时,科学家发现2022株病毒对小鼠整体健康的影响较小,其病毒传播更为受限,并且与A.1系相比,暴露于该株病毒后小鼠的存活率有所提高。 [news-1a28edb00e0adbff]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Mpox virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Health authorities confirmed another mpox infection in Karachi, bringing Sindh’s total confirmed cases this year to 43. The patient was brought to the Sindh Infectious Diseases Hospital after developing body rashes, and PCR tests confirmed the infection. [news-aa10ced59f5b434e]

A global initiative was launched to improve access to mpox vaccines and ensure equitable distribution during outbreaks. This initiative is based on the work of the World Health Organisation (WHO) and its partners, and it involves the International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision (ICG). [news-ac6c129fae712770]

Taiwan reported 30 confirmed mpox cases in 2026, including two new infections, with imported cases doubling from a year earlier and most cases linked to unprotected sexual contact, as stated by the Centers for Disease Control (CDC). [news-232f8a513a7ed92b]
Confirmed mpox cases rise from last year, with two new cases reported, including one local and one imported case. [news-fab0582cb6e73262]

Examining the impact of the virus on murine models, scientists found that the 2022 strain was less aggressive to the overall health of the mice who limited virus dissemination more effectively and had an increased survival rate after exposure to this strain compared to lineage A.1. [news-1a28edb00e0adbff]

一项全球倡议启动,旨在改善猴痘 疫苗的获取并确保暴发期间的公平分配。该倡议基于世界卫生组织(WHO)及其合作伙伴的工作,并涉及国际协调小组(ICG)。 [news-ac6c129fae712770]。
2026年台湾报告了30例猴痘确诊病例,包括新增的两例感染,其中输入性病例较前一年翻倍,大多数病例与未采取保护措施的性接触有关,如疾病管制署(CDC)所述。 [news-232f8a513a7ed92b]。
猴痘确诊病例较去年增加,报告了两例新病例,包括一例本地病例和一例输入病例。 [news-fab0582cb6e73262]。
brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following Mpox virus news developments.
Health authorities confirmed another mpox infection in Karachi, bringing Sindh’s total confirmed cases this year to 43.
A global initiative was launched to improve access to mpox vaccines and ensure equitable distribution during outbreaks.

Taiwan reported 30 confirmed mpox cases in 2026, including two new infections, with imported cases doubling from a year earlier and most cases linked to unprotected sexual contact, as stated by the Centers for Disease Control (CDC).
Confirmed mpox cases rise from last year, with two new cases reported, including one local and one imported case. [news-fab0582cb6e73262].

papers.title: A comprehensive overview of monkeypox virus disease.
papers.abstract: Monkeypox (mpox), caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV), re-emerged as a major global public health concern in 2022, resulting in widespread transmission beyond traditionally endemic regions. As of March 2026, 181,164 confirmed cases and 492 deaths had been reported across 144 countries globally. The unprecedented geographic spread of the outbreak highlighted important knowledge gaps in disease surveillance, prevention, and control. Given the ongoing global circulation of MPXV and the risk of future outbreaks, this review provides a comprehensive synthesis of current evidence on MPXV and mpox. The literature, surveillance data, and public health reports available up to March 2026 were systematically reviewed and synthesized. The review comprehensively assesses viral biology, genetic diversity, epidemiology, transmission dynamics, clinical manifestations, pathogenesis, laboratory diagnosis, infection during pregnancy, host immune responses, immune evasion mechanisms, therapeutic interventions, and prevention strategies. Globally, the decline in public immunity following the cessation of routine smallpox vaccination, together with ongoing viral evolution, may have contributed to the resurgence of mpox. Advances in genomic surveillance, diagnostics, and public health preparedness have strengthened outbreak response; however, important gaps remain in understanding long-term immunity and optimal treatment strategies. This review summarizes current evidence on MPXV and mpox and highlights priorities for future research and public health interventions. Suspect mpox in patients presenting with an unexplained rash, fever, and lymphadenopathy. The incubation period typically ranges from 7–14 days (up to 21 days). Immunocompromised individuals, people living with HIV, pregnant women, and children are at increased risk of severe disease and complications. RT-PCR testing of lesion-derived specimens remains the diagnostic gold standard for confirmation of mpox infection. Genomic sequencing may support clade identification and outbreak surveillance.

analysis.summary_en: This review provides a comprehensive overview of the mpox virus and its associated disease, highlighting the global resurgence of mpox in 2022 and its spread beyond traditional endemic regions. It reports 181,164 confirmed cases and 492 deaths as of March 2026, with a focus on high-risk populations such as immunocompromised individuals, people living with HIV, pregnant women, and children. The review emphasizes the role of RT-PCR testing and genomic sequencing in diagnosis and outbreak surveillance. It identifies key knowledge gaps, including long-term immunity and optimal treatment strategies, and outlines priorities for future research and public health interventions.

papers.title_zh: 猴痘病毒病的全面综述。
papers.source_body_en: Monkeypox (mpox), caused by monkeypox virus (MPXV), re-emerged as a major global public health concern in 2022, resulting in widespread transmission beyond traditionally endemic regions. As of March 2026, 181,164 confirmed cases and 492 deaths had been reported across 144 countries globally. The unprecedented geographic spread of the outbreak highlighted important knowledge gaps in disease surveillance, prevention, and control. Given the ongoing global circulation of MPXV and the risk of future outbreaks, this review provides a comprehensive synthesis of current evidence on MPXV and mpox. The literature, surveillance data, and public health reports available up to March 2026 were systematically reviewed and synthesized. The review comprehensively assesses viral biology, genetic diversity, epidemiology, transmission dynamics, clinical manifestations, pathogenesis, laboratory diagnosis, infection during pregnancy, host immune responses, immune evasion mechanisms, therapeutic interventions, and prevention strategies. Globally, the decline in public immunity following the cessation of routine smallpox vaccination, together with ongoing viral evolution, may have contributed to the resurgence of mpox. Advances in genomic surveillance, diagnostics, and public health preparedness have strengthened outbreak response; however, important gaps remain in understanding long-term immunity and optimal treatment strategies. This review summarizes current evidence on MPXV and mpox and highlights priorities for future research and public health interventions. Suspect mpox in patients presenting with an unexplained rash, fever, and lymphadenopathy. The incubation period typically ranges from 7–14 days (up to 21 days). Immunocompromised individuals, people living with HIV, pregnant women, and children are at increased risk of severe disease and complications. RT-PCR testing of lesion-derived specimens remains the diagnostic gold standard for confirmation of mpox infection. Genomic sequencing may support clade identification and outbreak surveillance.

papers.title: Smallpox Vaccine Elicits CD8 + T Cell Immunity Persisting Over Four Decades with Cross-Recognition of Monkeypox Virus
papers.abstract: Abstract Monkeypox, caused by MPXV, has become a global public health concern; however, the T-cell immunity against MPXV following smallpox vaccination remains unclear. In this study, we screened the immunogenicity of 21 predicted MPXV epitopes and compared immune responses between young and elderly groups. Two immunogenic CD8+ T-cell epitopes, M15 and M17, were identified, both of which effectively stimulated specific immune responses, with significantly stronger responses observed in the young group. Notably, this study provides the first evidence that smallpox vaccination induces CD8+ T-cell immunity that cross-recognizes the MPXV epitopes M15 and M17 and remains detectable for more than four decades after vaccination, as demonstrated in vaccinated individuals aged 53–75. These findings provide experimental evidence for understanding the cross-protective mechanisms of the smallpox vaccine and informing monkeypox vaccine development.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the T-cell immunity against MPXV following smallpox vaccination, as monkeypox has become a global public health concern and the long-term immune response to MPXV after smallpox vaccination remains unclear.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study screened the immunogenicity of 21 predicted MPXV epitopes and compared immune responses between young and elderly groups to assess the persistence and strength of CD8+ T-cell immunity.
analysis.methods: The researchers identified two immunogenic CD8+ T-cell epitopes, M15 and M17, and evaluated their ability to stimulate specific immune responses, comparing the results between young and elderly participants.
analysis.main_results: The study found that smallpox vaccination induces CD8+ T-cell immunity that cross-recognizes MPXV epitopes M15 and M17 and remains detectable for more than four decades after vaccination, as shown in individuals aged 53–75.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings offer experimental evidence for the cross-protective mechanisms of the smallpox vaccine against MPXV, highlighting its potential role in informing monkeypox vaccine development.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results contribute to understanding the long-term immune protection provided by smallpox vaccination against monkeypox, which could guide public health strategies for disease prevention and control.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study provides the first evidence of long-term CD8+ T-cell immunity against MPXV following smallpox vaccination, but it is limited to a specific age group and does not account for broader population variability.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the T-cell immunity against MPXV following smallpox vaccination, as monkeypox has become a global public health concern. The researchers screened the immunogenicity of 21 predicted MPXV epitopes and compared immune responses between young and elderly groups. They identified two CD8+ T-cell epitopes, M15 and M17, which effectively stimulated immune responses, with stronger responses observed in the young group. Notably, the study provides the first evidence that smallpox vaccination induces CD8+ T-cell immunity that cross-recognizes MPXV epitopes and persists for over four decades, as demonstrated in individuals aged 53–75. These findings offer experimental evidence for the cross-protective mechanisms of the smallpox vaccine against MPXV, which could inform future vaccine development. However, the study is limited to a specific age group and does not account for broader population variability, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究筛选了21个预测的MPXV表位的免疫原性,并比较了年轻组和老年组之间的免疫应答,以评估CD8+ T细胞免疫的持续性和强度。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员鉴定了两个具有免疫原性的CD8+ T细胞表位M15和M17,并评估了它们激活特定免疫应答的能力,比较了年轻和老年参与者的实验结果。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究发现,天花病毒疫苗接种诱导的CD8+ T细胞免疫可交叉识别猴痘病毒(MPXV)表位M15和M17,并且在疫苗接种感染后仍可检测超过四十年,如53至75岁个体所示。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现为天花病毒疫苗对MPXV的交叉保护机制提供了实验依据,突显了其在猴痘病毒疫苗开发中的潜在作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于理解天花疫苗疫苗接种对猴痘提供的长期免疫保护,这可能为疾病预防和控制的公共卫生策略提供指导。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究提供了首次关于在天花疫苗接种后对猴痘病毒(MPXV)产生长期CD8+ T细胞免疫的证据,但其结果仅限于特定年龄组,未能考虑更广泛的人群变异性。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 猴痘病毒(MPXV)引起的猴痘已成为全球公共卫生问题;然而,接种天花病毒疫苗后对MPXV的T细胞免疫仍不清楚。本研究筛选了21个预测的MPXV表位的免疫原性,并比较了年轻组和老年组之间的免疫应答。鉴定出两个具有免疫原性的CD8+ T细胞表位M15和M17,它们都能有效激活特定的免疫应答,年轻组的反应显著更强。值得注意的是,本研究首次提供了证据,表明天花病毒疫苗可诱导针对MPXV表位M15和M17的交叉识别的CD8+ T细胞免疫,并且在接种天花病毒疫苗后超过四十年仍可检测到,如53-75岁接种者所显示的。这些发现为理解天花病毒疫苗的交叉保护机制提供了实验依据,并有助于猴痘病毒疫苗的开发。

papers.title: Panton-Valentine Leucocidin-positive Staphylococcus aureus Skin Infection Mimicking Mpox in a Pediatric Returning Traveler.
papers.abstract: A 4-year-old boy developed a fever followed by painful, polymorphic skin lesions after travel to Cameroon, raising suspicion for mpox. Viral testing was negative; wound culture grew Panton-Valentine leucocidin-positive Staphylococcus aureus with additional, potentially synergistic virulence genes. This case demonstrates that the differential diagnosis of skin lesions following travel should include this increasingly recognized pathogen, prompting appropriate Panton-Valentine leucocidin testing.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to address the challenge of differentiating mpox from other infectious diseases in a pediatric traveler with skin lesions, highlighting the need for accurate diagnosis in the context of emerging pathogens.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A single-case study was conducted on a 4-year-old boy who developed fever and polymorphic skin lesions after returning from Cameroon, with the focus on identifying the causative agent of his illness.
analysis.methods: The patient's clinical presentation and travel history were evaluated, and viral testing was performed on skin lesions. Wound cultures were conducted to identify bacterial pathogens, including Panton-Valentine leucocidin-positive Staphylococcus aureus.
analysis.main_results: Viral testing was negative, and wound culture confirmed the presence of Panton-Valentine leucocidin-positive Staphylococcus aureus, which carried additional virulence genes.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted this case as a reminder that skin lesions in travelers may not always be caused by mpox, and they emphasized the importance of considering other pathogens, such as Staphylococcus aureus, in the differential diagnosis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the need for broader differential diagnosis in cases of skin lesions following travel, particularly in regions where mpox is endemic, to avoid misdiagnosis and ensure appropriate treatment.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its single-case design, which may not be representative of broader trends. However, the evidence is strong given the direct identification of the causative agent through wound culture.

analysis.summary_en: This case study describes a 4-year-old child who developed fever and polymorphic skin lesions after returning from Cameroon, initially suspected of having mpox. Viral testing was negative, and wound culture identified Panton-Valentine leucocidin-positive Staphylococcus aureus with additional virulence genes. The authors highlight the importance of considering bacterial pathogens in the differential diagnosis of skin lesions in returning travelers, especially in regions where mpox is prevalent. The study serves as a cautionary example for clinicians to avoid misdiagnosis and to incorporate appropriate testing for Staphylococcus aureus in such cases. The evidence is strong due to the direct identification of the causative agent, but the single-case design limits generalizability. This case contributes to the understanding of diagnostic challenges in pediatric infectious diseases and emphasizes the need for targeted testing in travel-related skin infections.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决一名有皮肤病变的儿童旅行者中区分猴痘与其他传染病的挑战,强调了在新兴病原体背景下准确进行诊断诊断的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在一名4岁男孩从喀麦隆返回后出现发热和多形性皮肤病变的情况下,进行了一项单病例研究,重点在于确定其疾病的致病原因。
elements_zh.methods: 患者的临床表现和旅行史进行了评估,并对皮肤病变进行了病毒检测。进行了伤口培养以鉴定细菌病原体,包括产生潘托-瓦伦丁 leukocidin 的金黄色葡萄球菌。
elements_zh.main_results: 病毒检测结果为阴性,伤口培养确认存在携带额外毒力基因的Panton-Valentine溶白细胞素阳性金黄色葡萄球菌。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此病例解释为一个提醒,即旅行者皮肤病变并不总是由猴痘引起,他们强调在鉴别诊断诊断时应考虑其他病原体,例如金黄色葡萄球菌。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了在旅行后出现皮肤病变的情况下,需要更广泛的鉴别诊断诊断,特别是在猴痘流行地区,以避免误诊并确保适当的治疗。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于其单病例设计,可能无法代表更广泛的趋势。然而,鉴于通过伤口培养直接鉴定出病原体,证据是强有力的。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to address the challenge of differentiating mpox from other infectious diseases in a pediatric traveler with skin lesions, highlighting the need for accurate diagnosis in the context of emerging pathogens.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A single-case study was conducted on a 4-year-old boy who developed fever and polymorphic skin lesions after returning from Cameroon, with the focus on identifying the causative agent of his illness.
analysis_en.methods: The patient's clinical presentation and travel history were evaluated, and viral testing was performed on skin lesions. Wound cultures were conducted to identify bacterial pathogens, including Panton-Valentine leucocidin-positive Staphylococcus aureus.
analysis_en.main_results: Viral testing was negative, and wound culture confirmed the presence of Panton-Valentine leucocidin-positive Staphylococcus aureus, which carried additional virulence genes.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted this case as a reminder that skin lesions in travelers may not always be caused by mpox, and they emphasized the importance of considering other pathogens, such as Staphylococcus aureus, in the differential diagnosis.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the need for broader differential diagnosis in cases of skin lesions following travel, particularly in regions where mpox is endemic, to avoid misdiagnosis and ensure appropriate treatment.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its single-case design, which may not be representative of broader trends. However, the evidence is strong given the direct identification of the causative agent through wound culture.

papers.title_zh: 归国旅行儿童中酷似猴痘的Panton-Valentine杀白细胞素阳性金黄色葡萄球菌皮肤感染
papers.source_body_en: A 4-year-old boy developed a fever followed by painful, polymorphic skin lesions after travel to Cameroon, raising suspicion for mpox. Viral testing was negative; wound culture grew Panton-Valentine leucocidin-positive Staphylococcus aureus with additional, potentially synergistic virulence genes. This case demonstrates that the differential diagnosis of skin lesions following travel should include this increasingly recognized pathogen, prompting appropriate Panton-Valentine leucocidin testing.
papers.abstract_zh: 一名4岁男孩在前往喀麦隆旅行后出现发热,随后出现疼痛性、多形性皮肤病变,引发了对猴痘的怀疑。病毒检测结果为阴性;伤口培养出携带Panton-Valentine溶血素的金黄色葡萄球菌,并伴有其他可能具有协同作用的毒力基因。该病例表明,在旅行后出现皮肤病变的情况下,应将诊断纳入鉴别诊断考虑范围,以促使进行适当的Panton-Valentine溶血素检测。

papers.title: Willingness to receive monkeypox vaccine and associated factors among the Ghanaian population: Findings from a nationwide survey
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The World Health Organization recommends vaccination as an important public health intervention for controlling mpox outbreaks globally. The willingness to receive mpox vaccine and associated determinants is not fully understood in Ghana. The study therefore assessed Ghanaians' willingness to receive mpox vaccine and the associated factors using the 5 C vaccine uptake model. Methods This was a nationwide cross-sectional online survey conducted between July and October 2025 in Ghana. The study was conducted and reported in line with the STROBE Checklist for cross-sectional studies. The questionnaire was adopted and modified based on the five psychological antecedents of vaccination (confidence, complacency, constraints, calculation, and collective responsibility) and the WHO frequently asked questions on mpox. Descriptive statistics, chi-square test, and multivariate analysis were performed using Stata version 17. Results The study involved 1670 respondents, with most of them in the 18–22 years age category (761, 45.61%) and predominantly females (1296, 77.60%). Most of the respondents indicated their willingness to take the vaccine (1006, 60.24%). Vaccine confidence (p ≤ 0.001), complacency (p ≤ 0.001), and calculation (p = 0.003) were significantly associated with the willingness to receive mpox vaccine. Age 23–27 years was significantly associated with higher odds of receiving the mpox vaccine (aOR = 1.41; 95% CI: 1.11–1.80; p = 0.005). Respondents in the Bono (aOR = 2.67; 95% CI: 1.32–5.42; p = 0.007), North-East (aOR = 2.29; 95% CI: 1.11–4.76; p = 0.026), and Savannah (aOR = 1.91; 95% CI: 1.01–3.28; p = 0.048) regions were significantly associated with higher odds of receiving the mpox vaccine. High vaccine confidence (aOR = 1.75; 95% CI: 1.40–2.20; p = p ≤ 0.001) and calculation (aOR = 1.73; 95% CI: 1.35–2.06; p = p ≤ 0.001) were also associated with higher odds of willingness to receive the mpox vaccine. Conclusion Willingness to receive the mpox vaccine was high among the respondents. Tailored interventions aimed at improving vaccine confidence, complacency, and calculation are recommended. Such interventions should be age-appropriate and consider regions with low vaccine willingness rates.

The results can inform public health strategies to enhance mpox vaccine acceptance in Ghana.

Respondents in the Bono (aOR = 2.67; 95% CI: 1.32–5.42; p = 0.007), North-East (aOR = 2.29; 95% CI: 1.11–4.76; p = 0.026), and Savannah (aOR = 1.91; 95% CI: 1.01–3.28; p = 0.048) regions were significantly associated with higher odds of receiving the mpox vaccine. High vaccine confidence (aOR = 1.75; 95% CI: 1.40–2.20; p = p ≤ 0.001) and calculation (aOR = 1.73; 95% CI: 1.35–2.06; p = p ≤ 0.001) were also associated with higher odds of willingness to receive the mpox vaccine. Conclusion Willingness to receive the mpox vaccine was high among the respondents. Tailored interventions aimed at improving vaccine confidence, complacency, and calculation are recommended. Such interventions should be age-appropriate and consider regions with low vaccine willingness rates.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估加纳人口接受猴痘 疫苗的意愿,并确定相关因素,因为目前对加纳人群中接受猴痘 疫苗的意愿及其相关决定因素的理解尚不充分。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项调查是在2025年7月至10月期间在加纳全国范围内进行的一项横断面在线调查,共涉及1670名受访者,其中大多数年龄在18–22岁之间,且以女性为主。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用Stata 17进行描述性统计、卡方检验和多变量分析。问卷是基于疫苗接种的五个心理前因(信心、轻视、限制、计算和集体责任)以及WHO关于猴痘的常见问题进行采用和修改的。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为表明受访者中对猴痘和疫苗的接受意愿较高,接受意愿与诸如疫苗的自信、自满和计算等因素存在显著关联。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为制定有针对性的干预措施提供信息,以提高疫苗的信心、轻敌和计算能力,从而增强猴痘在加纳的接种率。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究按照横断面研究的STROBE清单进行了开展和报告,这为方法学和报告提供了中等程度的信心。

papers.title: Maternal and neonatal mpox in Nigeria: a multicentre case series highlighting diagnostic challenges, transmission pathways, and neonatal outcomes
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Mpox during pregnancy and the neonatal period is uncommon, and evidence regarding maternal clinical presentation, neonatal acquisition, and pregnancy outcomes remains limited, particularly in endemic African settings. Data on maternal–neonatal pairs infected with Clade IIb monkeypox virus (MPXV) are especially scarce. We describe the clinical characteristics, diagnostic challenges, potential transmission pathways, and outcomes of three mother–infant pairs managed at hospitals in southern Nigeria. Case presentation We conducted a retrospective multicentre case series involving three mothers with probable mpox during late pregnancy and their three neonates with laboratory-confirmed mpox managed at two tertiary teaching hospitals and one private specialist hospital in southern Nigeria. All mothers developed acute febrile illnesses during the third trimester or immediately before delivery. Two presented with characteristic vesiculopustular eruptions, whereas one experienced a self-limiting febrile illness without recognised cutaneous lesions. None underwent laboratory testing during pregnancy and were retrospectively classified as probable maternal mpox according to the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) case definition following laboratory confirmation of MPXV infection in their newborns. All three male neonates presented within the first three weeks of life with fever and disseminated vesiculopustular eruptions. MPXV infection was confirmed by real-time polymerase chain reaction (PCR), and varicella-zoster virus infection was excluded where tested. Two neonates had low cycle threshold values, consistent with a high viral DNA burden. All infants received supportive care. Two recovered completely, whereas one died following early hospital discharge due to financial constraints. All mothers recovered without major complications. Although the temporal relationship between parental illness and neonatal disease suggested epidemiological linkage within the household, the precise route of neonatal acquisition could not be determined because transplacental, intrapartum, and early postnatal transmission remained plausible. Conclusions This multicentre case series expands the limited evidence on maternal and neonatal mpox in a clade IIb endemic African setting and highlights the diagnostic challenges of recognising mpox during pregnancy. Our findings demonstrate a spectrum of neonatal outcomes and underscore the uncertainty surrounding neonatal acquisition. Prospective studies that incorporate comprehensive maternal, neonatal, placental, and household investigations together with viral genomic sequencing are needed to clarify transmission pathways and inform evidence-based strategies for the diagnosis, management, and prevention of mpox during pregnancy and the neonatal period.

papers.title_zh: 尼日利亚母胎猴痘在多中心病例系列中的诊断挑战、传播途径及新生儿结局
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Mpox during pregnancy and the neonatal period is uncommon, and evidence regarding maternal clinical presentation, neonatal acquisition, and pregnancy outcomes remains limited, particularly in endemic African settings. Data on maternal–neonatal pairs infected with Clade IIb monkeypox virus (MPXV) are especially scarce. We describe the clinical characteristics, diagnostic challenges, potential transmission pathways, and outcomes of three mother–infant pairs managed at hospitals in southern Nigeria. Case presentation We conducted a retrospective multicentre case series involving three mothers with probable mpox during late pregnancy and their three neonates with laboratory-confirmed mpox managed at two tertiary teaching hospitals and one private specialist hospital in southern Nigeria. All mothers developed acute febrile illnesses during the third trimester or immediately before delivery. Two presented with characteristic vesiculopustular eruptions, whereas one experienced a self-limiting febrile illness without recognised cutaneous lesions. None underwent laboratory testing during pregnancy and were retrospectively classified as probable maternal mpox according to the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) case definition following laboratory confirmation of MPXV infection in their newborns. All three male neonates presented within the first three weeks of life with fever and disseminated vesiculopustular eruptions. MPXV infection was confirmed by real-time polymerase chain reaction (PCR), and varicella-zoster virus infection was excluded where tested. Two neonates had low cycle threshold values, consistent with a high viral DNA burden. All infants received supportive care. Two recovered completely, whereas one died following early hospital discharge due to financial constraints. All mothers recovered without major complications. Although the temporal relationship between parental illness and neonatal disease suggested epidemiological linkage within the household, the precise route of neonatal acquisition could not be determined because transplacental, intrapartum, and early postnatal transmission remained plausible. Conclusions This multicentre case series expands the limited evidence on maternal and neonatal mpox in a clade IIb endemic African setting and highlights the diagnostic challenges of recognising mpox during pregnancy. Our findings demonstrate a spectrum of neonatal outcomes and underscore the uncertainty surrounding neonatal acquisition. Prospective studies that incorporate comprehensive maternal, neonatal, placental, and household investigations together with viral genomic sequencing are needed to clarify transmission pathways and inform evidence-based strategies for the diagnosis, management, and prevention of mpox during pregnancy and the neonatal period.

papers.title: A Practical Clinical Review of Recognition, Diagnosis, Initial Management, and Referral of MPOX
papers.abstract: Mpox can present to primary care with a wide spectrum of skin and mucosal disease, ranging from a few localized lesions to disseminated or complicated infection. Contemporary presentations may lack the classical generalized rash or prominent systemic prodrome, creating diagnostic overlap with herpes simplex, varicella-zoster, syphilis, molluscum contagiosum, bacterial skin disease, and other causes of vesicular, pustular, or ulcerative lesions. Primary-care clinicians therefore have a key role in recognition before laboratory confirmation. This practical clinical review provides a frontline approach to suspicion, immediate infection-prevention measures, lesion-based PCR testing, assessment for important coinfections, severity stratification, supportive management, and timely referral. The central sequence is: suspect mpox, protect patients and staff, test appropriately, assess severity and risk, and determine safe outpatient management versus escalation of care.

Contemporary presentations may lack the classical generalized rash or prominent systemic prodrome, creating diagnostic overlap with herpes simplex, varicella-zoster, syphilis, molluscum contagiosum, bacterial skin disease, and other causes of vesicular, pustular, or ulcerative lesions. Primary-care clinicians therefore have a key role in recognition before laboratory confirmation. This practical clinical review provides a frontline approach to suspicion, immediate infection-prevention measures, lesion-based PCR testing, assessment for important coinfections, severity stratification, supportive management, and timely referral. The central sequence is: suspect mpox, protect patients and staff, test appropriately, assess severity and risk, and determine safe outpatient management versus escalation of care.

papers.title: Development and evaluation of a two-tube multiplex real-time PCR assay for differential detection of Monkeypox virus clades Ia, Ib, IIa, and IIb
papers.abstract: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) has caused two Public Health Emergencies of International Concern since 2022, with co-circulation of distinct clades (Ia, Ib, IIa, IIb) that differ in virulence and transmission patterns. Rapid discrimination of these clades is critical for outbreak control and clinical management. Here, we developed and validated a two-tube multiplex real-time quantitative PCR (qPCR) assay targeting the H3L gene, designed to first distinguish clade I from clade II, followed by subtyping into clades Ia, Ib, IIa, and IIb in separate reactions. The assay demonstrated high sensitivity, with detection limits of 100 copies/reaction for clade Ia, 10 copies/reaction for clade Ib, 10 copies/reaction for clade IIa, and 1 copy/reaction for clade IIb using standard plasmids. Excellent specificity was confirmed by the absence of cross-reactivity with nucleic acids from other human pathogens, including vaccinia virus Tiantan strain (VTT), human adenovirus (HAdV), getah virus (GETV), chikungunya virus (CHIKV), Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), dengue virus (DENV), influenza A virus (IAV), influenza B virus (IBV), and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2). The assay exhibited high repeatability, with intra-assay coefficients of variation (CVs) ranging from 0.09 to 1.88% and inter-assay CVs from 0.23 to 2.68%. Clinical evaluation using 48 skin samples from infected crab-eating monkeys or SCID mice showed 100% concordance with singleplex qPCR for clade IIb detection. For clades Ia, Ib, and IIa, clinical validation was not feasible due to sample unavailability, and their performance was analytically confirmed using recombinant plasmids. Importantly, the clade assignment of the 48 animal specimens was not confirmed by sequencing, which represents a limitation of the current study. Furthermore, these specimens were derived from animal models rather than human patients; thus, the results represent preclinical validation, and formal clinical validation in human specimens from endemic regions is warranted. This two-tube multiplex qPCR assay provides a rapid, sensitive, and reliable tool for the analytical discrimination of all four major MPXV clades, with preliminary clinical validation for clade IIb. Its ability to distinguish emerging clades makes it a valuable asset for clinical diagnosis, epidemiological surveillance, and future outbreak preparedness, although further clinical validation in endemic regions is required.

papers.title: Mathematical Analysis of Mpox in HumanPopulation:TheEffectsof Vaccination Strategies
papers.abstract: In this researchwork,afractional-ordermodelofmonkeypoxdiseasetransmissionwithinthe human population isformulatedandstudied.Theformulatedmodelincorporatestwocontrol strategies namely; vaccination and health education campaign. In model analysis, the disease free-equilibrium and basic reproduction number, are computed. The existence and unique ness of model solution using fixed point theorem have been analyzed. Meanwhile, the global stability of the model have been performed using well formulated Lyapunov function and the results showedthatthemodel isstablewhen 0 1.Inmodelsim ulations, parameter estimation using reported cases of monkeypox disease from Democratic Republic of Congo have been performed to compare the results for fractional ( = 0.5) and integer ( = 1) order derivatives. The results showed that fitting the model at = 0.5 had good results compared to when = 1.Implyingthatfractional model presented good results comparedtointeger-orderderivatives.Besides,weperformedSensitivityanalysisofthebasic reproduction number using computed partial rank correlation coefficients to investigate the impactofeachparameteronthedisease transmission.Furthermore,weperformednumerical simulation of the model to assess the impact of memory effects on the spread of monkeypox virus transmission in the population. Additionally, numerical simulation to investigate the effects of health education and vaccination was performed. Overall, the results showed that whentheefficacyoffirst-dosevaccinationwaschangedfrom75%to95%andtherateofhealth education campaign retained at 0.1thethresholdquantity 0 remainedgreaterthanunity.In contrastwhentheefficacyoffirst-dosevaccinationwaschangedfrom75%to95%andtherate ofhealtheducationcampaignchangedfrom0.1to0.9thethresholdquantity 0 wasobserved to be less than unity. The results have implication that the efficacy of first-dose vaccination must be greater than 95%andrateofhealtheducation campaignmustbegreaterthat 0.9 for the disease to eliminated in the population Monkeypox virus (MPXV) transmission remains an important public health concern, particularly in populations where vaccination coverage, disease surveillance, and access to effective preventive measures are limited. Mathematical modelling provides a valuable framework for understanding MPXV transmission dynamics and assessing the effectiveness of control interventions by describing the interactions among susceptible, vaccinated, exposed,andinfectiouspopulations.Inparticular,incorporatingfirst andsecond-dose vaccination into transmission models allows the differential protection pro videdbysuccessivevaccinedosestobeexamined,togetherwithvaccinationratesandvaccine efficacy. Parameter estimation using reported MPXV cases is essential for calibrating the modelandimproving itsabilitytodescribeobserveddiseasepatterns.Suchmodelscanalsobe used to determine key epidemiological quantities, including the basic reproduction number, and to evaluate the effects of vaccination and other interventions on disease transmission. Therefore,integratingMPXVmodelformulation,parameterestimation,andfirst-andsecond dose vaccination provides a useful mathematical framework for identifying effective control strategies and establishing conditions under which MPXV transmission can be reduced and potentially eliminated from the population.
papers.journal: MUST Journal of Research and Development.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to analyze the effects of vaccination strategies on the transmission dynamics of mpox virus within the human population, addressing the public health concern of limited vaccination coverage and preventive measures.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A fractional-order mathematical model of mpox disease transmission was formulated and studied within the human population, incorporating two control strategies: vaccination and health education campaigns. The model was analyzed using reported cases of monkeypox disease from the Democratic Republic of Congo.
analysis.methods: The model's disease-free equilibrium and basic reproduction number were computed. The existence and uniqueness of the model solution were analyzed using the fixed point theorem. Global stability was assessed using a well-formulated Lyapunov function. Sensitivity analysis of the basic reproduction number was conducted using computed partial rank correlation coefficients. Numerical simulations were performed to evaluate the impact of memory effects on disease transmission.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that the fractional-order model (with = 0.5) provided better fitting compared to the integer-order model (with = 1). When the efficacy of first-dose vaccination was increased from 75% to 95% while retaining the health education campaign rate at 0.1, the threshold quantity 0 remained greater than unity. However, when the health education campaign rate was increased from 0.1 to 0.9, the threshold quantity 0 was observed to be less than unity.

papers.title: Analysis of Mpox intervention measures in presence of environmental transmission pathway using data from DRC
papers.abstract: This paper develops a mathematical model for Mpox transmission dynamics accounting for disease transmission through interpersonal contact as well as from microbes infested environment. The endemic equilibrium of the model was evaluated for two cases. (1) When it is assumed that the microbes in the environment play no role in the spread of the disease, and it was shown that the endemic equilibrium is unique, exists when R 0 is greater than unity, and is globally asymptotically stable. (2) For the case when environmental microbes concentration plays a role in disease transmission, the model was shown to possibly exhibit backward bifurcation at R 0 . This indicates that lowering R 0 below 1 may not eliminate Mpox when the disease is already endemic, due to the stable endemic equilibrium. Numerical results, based on outbreak data from the DRC indicate that; (1) increased interpersonal contact has the potential of making the disease worse, (2) high isolation rate and accelerated recovery of infected individuals through any possible intervention can easily contain the disease. The results further show that environmental contamination does not substantially influence disease transmission rates. More still, it is observed that implementation of influential mitigation measures results in lower and delayed peaks of the number of infected. This is essential for healthcare systems to prepare for more emergency cases and isolation facilities when needed most especially in under resourced communities or countries. Our findings highlight the need for comprehensive interventions addressing both behavioural and environmental factors, especially in environments with limited resources.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本文开发了一个数学模型,用于分析猴痘 传播动态,考虑了通过人际接触以及微生物污染环境传播疾病的影响。本研究旨在了解环境传播在猴痘传播中的作用以及干预措施的有效性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了一个数学模型的流行病学平衡点,分为两种情况:一种是环境微生物在疾病传播中不起作用,另一种是它们起作用。该模型基于DRC的暴发数据。
elements_zh.methods: 该模型被评估为两种情况:(1) 当环境微生物在疾病传播中不起作用时,以及(2) 当它们起作用时。数值结果基于DRC的暴发数据。
elements_zh.main_results: 数值结果表明,增加的人际接触可能使疾病恶化,而高隔离率和通过任何可能干预手段加速感染者康复可以控制疾病。环境污染对疾病传播率的影响不大。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果表明,当疾病已经流行时,即使将R0降低到1以下,也可能无法消除猴痘,因为存在稳定的流行病学平衡点。研究结果强调了需要综合干预措施,同时关注行为和环境因素,尤其是在资源有限的社区中。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为医疗系统提供信息,使其在资源不足的社区中准备应对更多紧急病例和隔离设施。它们还强调了在猴痘控制中同时关注行为和环境因素的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于使用了数学模型,并且依赖于DRC的暴发数据。

papers.title: Discrepancies between subjective and objective risk perceptions of monkeypox infection among MSM in China
papers.abstract: The global resurgence of monkeypox presents a growing public health concern, particularly among men who have sex with men (MSM). Accurate risk perception is critical for effective prevention. However, discrepancies between subjective and objective risk perceptions of monkeypox infection remain insufficiently studied in China. A nationwide cross-sectional survey was conducted from 2023 to 2024 across 30 provinces. MSM were recruited through community-based organizations (CBOs) and voluntary counseling and testing (VCT) clinics. Participants completed an anonymous online questionnaire assessing sociodemographic characteristics, sexual behaviors, monkeypox knowledge, and both subjective and objective infection risk perceptions. Stratified logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with risk misperceptions. A total of 14,325 valid responses were analyzed. Of these, 46.66% (6,684) were high-risk MSM, and 71.78% (10,283) reported awareness of monkeypox-related knowledge. Among high-risk MSM, 11.70% (782) reported unexplained rashes or lesions mainly in the genital or perianal regions, while 4.22% (33) adopted no preventive measures despite potential exposure. Discrepancies in risk perception were observed, with 9.14% (611) underestimating and 22.31% (1,491) overestimating their infection risk, and 1.15% (9) showing severe mismatches between subjective and objective assessments. Younger age (18-25 years), residence in western regions, and offline partner-seeking behaviors were associated with risk underestimation, whereas higher education and online partner-seeking behaviors were associated with risk overestimation. Significant discrepancies existed between subjective and objective monkeypox infection risk perceptions among MSM in China, with overestimation more prevalent despite adequate knowledge levels. Tailored interventions addressing cognitive biases and behaviors are essential to enhance risk accuracy and prevention.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the insufficient understanding of discrepancies between subjective and objective risk perceptions of monkeypox infection among men who have sex with men (MSM) in China.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A nationwide cross-sectional survey was conducted from 2023 to 2024 across 30 provinces, recruiting MSM through community-based organizations (CBOs) and voluntary counseling and testing (VCT) clinics.
analysis.methods: Stratified logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with risk misperceptions, and participants completed an anonymous online questionnaire assessing sociodemographic characteristics, sexual behaviors, monkeypox knowledge, and both subjective and objective infection risk perceptions.
analysis.main_results: Of the 14,325 valid responses, 46.66% (6,684) were high-risk MSM, and 71.78% (10,283) reported awareness of monkeypox-related knowledge. Among high-risk MSM, 11.70% (782) reported unexplained rashes or lesions mainly in the genital or perianal regions, while 4.22% (33) adopted no preventive measures despite potential exposure.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors observed significant discrepancies in risk perception, with overestimation more prevalent despite adequate knowledge levels, highlighting the need for targeted interventions to improve risk accuracy.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the development of tailored interventions addressing cognitive biases and behaviors to enhance risk accuracy and prevention among high-risk MSM in China.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on self-reported data and the potential for recall bias, but the large sample size and nationwide scope provide moderate confidence in the results.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated discrepancies between subjective and objective risk perceptions of monkeypox infection among men who have sex with men (MSM) in China. A nationwide cross-sectional survey from 2023 to 2024 collected data from 14,325 participants through community-based organizations and voluntary counseling clinics. The results showed that 46.66% of participants were high-risk, with 71.78% aware of monkeypox-related knowledge. Among high-risk individuals, 11.70% reported unexplained rashes, and 4.22% took no preventive measures. The authors noted that overestimation of risk was more common than underestimation, despite sufficient knowledge. They emphasized the need for interventions targeting cognitive biases and behaviors to improve risk perception accuracy. The study's large sample size and broad geographic reach provide moderate confidence in its findings, though self-reported data may introduce bias.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨中国男男性行为者(MSM)中猴痘感染主观与客观风险感知差异的不足理解。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023年至2024年间,一项全国范围的横断面调查在30个省份展开,通过社区组织(CBOs)和自愿咨询与检测(VCT)诊所招募MSM。
elements_zh.methods: 采用分层逻辑回归分析以识别与风险误判相关的因素,参与者完成了匿名在线问卷,评估其社会人口学特征、性行为、猴痘相关知识以及主观和客观感染风险感知。

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A nationwide cross-sectional survey was conducted from 2023 to 2024 across 30 provinces, recruiting MSM through community-based organizations (CBOs) and voluntary counseling and testing (VCT) clinics.
analysis_en.methods: Stratified logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with risk misperceptions, and participants completed an anonymous online questionnaire assessing sociodemographic characteristics, sexual behaviors, monkeypox knowledge, and both subjective and objective infection risk perceptions.
analysis_en.main_results: Of the 14,325 valid responses, 46.66% (6,684) were high-risk MSM, and 71.78% (10,283) reported awareness of monkeypox-related knowledge. Among high-risk MSM, 11.70% (782) reported unexplained rashes or lesions mainly in the genital or perianal regions, while 4.22% (33) adopted no preventive measures despite potential exposure.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors observed significant discrepancies in risk perception, with overestimation more prevalent despite adequate knowledge levels, highlighting the need for targeted interventions to improve risk accuracy.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the development of tailored interventions addressing cognitive biases and behaviors to enhance risk accuracy and prevention among high-risk MSM in China.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on self-reported data and the potential for recall bias, but the large sample size and nationwide scope provide moderate confidence in the results.

papers.title_zh: 中国男男性行为者中猴痘感染主观与客观风险感知之间的差异
papers.source_body_en: The global resurgence of monkeypox presents a growing public health concern, particularly among men who have sex with men (MSM). Accurate risk perception is critical for effective prevention. However, discrepancies between subjective and objective risk perceptions of monkeypox infection remain insufficiently studied in China. A nationwide cross-sectional survey was conducted from 2023 to 2024 across 30 provinces. MSM were recruited through community-based organizations (CBOs) and voluntary counseling and testing (VCT) clinics. Participants completed an anonymous online questionnaire assessing sociodemographic characteristics, sexual behaviors, monkeypox knowledge, and both subjective and objective infection risk perceptions. Stratified logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with risk misperceptions. A total of 14,325 valid responses were analyzed. Of these, 46.66% (6,684) were high-risk MSM, and 71.78% (10,283) reported awareness of monkeypox-related knowledge. Among high-risk MSM, 11.70% (782) reported unexplained rashes or lesions mainly in the genital or perianal regions, while 4.22% (33) adopted no preventive measures despite potential exposure. Discrepancies in risk perception were observed, with 9.14% (611) underestimating and 22.31% (1,491) overestimating their infection risk, and 1.15% (9) showing severe mismatches between subjective and objective assessments. Younger age (18-25 years), residence in western regions, and offline partner-seeking behaviors were associated with risk underestimation, whereas higher education and online partner-seeking behaviors were associated with risk overestimation. Significant discrepancies existed between subjective and objective monkeypox infection risk perceptions among MSM in China, with overestimation more prevalent despite adequate knowledge levels. Tailored interventions addressing cognitive biases and behaviors are essential to enhance risk accuracy and prevention.

papers.title: Improving mpox identification under imbalanced data using geometric transformation and color augmentation with graph neural networks
papers.abstract: Mpox lesion identification from skin images remains challenging because lesion appearances often overlap with other dermatological diseases and available data are commonly imbalanced. This study proposes a graph-based multi-class classification framework that combines class-balancing augmentation, convolutional neural network (CNN)-based feature extraction, and graph neural classification. Experiments were conducted on the Mpox Skin Lesion Dataset Version 2.0 using three data configurations: (i) the original imbalanced data, (ii) a balanced version generated through geometric transformation augmentation, and (iii) a balanced version generated through combined geometric transformation and color-space augmentation. Image features were extracted using eight CNN backbones (EfficientNetB4, AlexNet, VGG16, ResNet50, DenseNet121, GoogleNetV3/InceptionV3, MobileNetV2, and LeNet), then transformed into graphs by selecting k-nearest-neighbor candidates and retaining edges according to cosine-similarity filtering, and finally classified using graph convolutional networks (GCN) and graph attention networks (GAT). Across 48 model combinations, data balancing improved macro-level performance compared with the original imbalanced setting. The best overall result was achieved by GCN with VGG16 on the geometrically and color-augmented balanced data, reaching 92.00% accuracy, 91.55% macro F1-score, 98.81% macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (one-versus-rest), 93.54% macro precision, and 90.32% macro recall. The best GAT result was obtained by MobileNetV2 on the geometrically augmented balanced data, with 90.67% accuracy, 89.25% macro F1-score, 98.48% macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (one-versus-rest), 89.28% macro precision, and 90.27% macro recall. Although GCN showed a more consistent empirical performance trend than GAT, the difference was not statistically significant. These findings indicate that integrating balanced augmentation, CNN-derived representations, and graph learning is a promising strategy for mpox lesion identification within the scope of the present experiments; however, broader external validation and explainability-oriented analysis are still required before real-world clinical deployment.

Experiments were conducted on the Mpox Skin Lesion Dataset Version 2.0 using three data configurations: (i) the original imbalanced data, (ii) a balanced version generated through geometric transformation augmentation, and (iii) a balanced version generated through combined geometric transformation and color-space augmentation. Image features were extracted using eight CNN backbones (EfficientNetB4, AlexNet, VGG16, ResNet50, DenseNet121, GoogleNetV3/InceptionV3, MobileNetV2, and LeNet), then transformed into graphs by selecting k-nearest-neighbor candidates and retaining edges according to cosine-similarity filtering, and finally classified using graph convolutional networks (GCN) and graph attention networks (GAT). Across 48 model combinations, data balancing improved macro-level performance compared with the original imbalanced setting. The best overall result was achieved by GCN with VGG16 on the geometrically and color-augmented balanced data, reaching 92.00% accuracy, 91.55% macro F1-score, 98.81% macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (one-versus-rest), 93.54% macro precision, and 90.32% macro recall. The best GAT result was obtained by MobileNetV2 on the geometrically augmented balanced data, with 90.67% accuracy, 89.25% macro F1-score, 98.48% macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (one-versus-rest), 89.28% macro precision, and 90.27% macro recall. Although GCN showed a more consistent empirical performance trend than GAT, the difference was not statistically significant. These findings indicate that integrating balanced augmentation, CNN-derived representations, and graph learning is a promising strategy for mpox lesion identification within the scope of the present experiments; however, broader external validation and explainability-oriented analysis are still required before real-world clinical deployment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 从皮肤图像中识别猴痘病变仍然具有挑战性,因为病变外观通常与其他皮肤病重叠,且可用数据通常不平衡。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究提出了一种基于图的多类分类框架,结合了类别平衡增强、基于卷积神经网络(CNN)的特征提取和图神经网络分类。实验在猴痘皮肤病变数据集版本2.0上进行,使用了三种数据配置:(i) 原始不平衡数据,(ii) 通过几何变换增强生成的平衡版本,以及 (iii) 通过结合几何变换和颜色空间增强生成的平衡版本。
elements_zh.methods: 使用八个CNN主干网络(EfficientNetB4、AlexNet、VGG16、ResNet50、DenseNet121、GoogleNetV3/InceptionV3、MobileNetV2和LeNet)提取图像特征,然后通过选择k近邻候选并根据余弦相似度过滤保留边,将这些特征转换为图,最后使用图卷积网络(GCN)和图注意力网络(GAT)进行分类。
elements_zh.main_results: 在48种模型组合中,数据平衡提高了宏观层面的性能,与原始不平衡设置相比。在几何和颜色增强后的平衡数据上,GCN与VGG16组合实现了最佳整体结果,准确率达到92.00%,宏观F1分数为91.55%,宏观受试者工作特征曲线下面积(one-versus-rest)为98.81%,宏观精确度为93.54%,宏观召回率为90.32%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 尽管GCN表现出比GAT更一致的实证性能趋势,但差异并不具有统计学意义。这些发现表明,在当前实验范围内,将平衡增强、CNN衍生表示和图学习相结合是一种有前景的策略,用于猴痘病变识别。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,所提出的方法可能在临床环境中提高猴痘病变识别的准确性,这对于早期诊断和有效的公共卫生响应至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告与研究设计或外部验证相关的局限性,但结果基于当前实验,因此在实际临床部署之前需要更广泛的验证。

papers.abstract_zh: 从皮肤图像中识别猴痘病变仍然具有挑战性,因为病变外观通常与其他皮肤病重叠,且可用数据通常不平衡。本研究提出了一种基于图的多类分类框架,结合了类别平衡增强、基于卷积神经网络(CNN)的特征提取和图神经网络分类。实验在猴痘皮肤病变数据集版本2.0上进行,使用了三种数据配置:(i) 原始不平衡数据,(ii) 通过几何变换增强生成的平衡版本,以及 (iii) 通过结合几何变换和颜色空间增强生成的平衡版本。使用八个CNN主干网络(EfficientNetB4、AlexNet、VGG16、ResNet50、DenseNet121、GoogleNetV3/InceptionV3、MobileNetV2和LeNet)提取图像特征,然后通过选择k近邻候选并根据余弦相似度过滤保留边,将这些特征转换为图,最后使用图卷积网络(GCN)和图注意力网络(GAT)进行分类。在48种模型组合中,数据平衡提高了宏观层面的性能,与原始不平衡设置相比。在几何和颜色增强后的平衡数据上,GCN与VGG16组合实现了最佳整体结果,准确率达到92.00%,宏观F1分数为91.55%,宏观受试者工作特征曲线下面积(one-versus-rest)为98.81%,宏观精确度为93.54%,宏观召回率为90.32%。在几何增强后的平衡数据上,MobileNetV2实现了最佳GAT结果,准确率为90.67%,宏观F1分数为89.25%,宏观受试者工作特征曲线下面积(one-versus-rest)为98.48%,宏观精确度为89.28%,宏观召回率为90.27%。尽管GCN表现出比GAT更一致的实证性能趋势,但差异并不具有统计学意义。这些发现表明,在当前实验范围内,将平衡增强、CNN衍生表示和图学习相结合是一种有前景的策略,用于猴痘病变识别。然而,在实际临床部署之前,仍需要更广泛的外部验证和以可解释性为导向的分析。

papers.title: A retrospective comparative diagnostic evaluation of three commercial qPCR kits for the diagnosis of mpox virus on an enriched sample set
papers.abstract: Mpox virus (MPXV) is an enveloped double-stranded DNA virus belonging to the genus Orthopoxvirus within the family Poxviridae . It causes a zoonotic disease transmitted to humans through direct contact with infected animals or humans, as well as through exposure to contaminated materials. The aim of this study was to conduct a retrospective, comparative diagnostic evaluation of three commercial real-time PCR (qPCR) kits for the diagnosis of MPXV on an enriched, artificially balanced sample set that included 50% MPXV-positive samples. World Health Organization (WHO) reference molecular protocol was used as the reference comparator. A total of 300 clinical specimens, 150 of them MPXV-positive (265 skin lesion/vesicle swabs and 35 serum samples), were used in this analysis. The Bioperfectus kit correctly identified 294/300 samples, showing a sensitivity of 0.96 (95% CI: 0.93–0.99), a specificity of 1.00 (0.98–1.00), and a Cohen’s Kappa coefficient of 0.96 (95% CI: 0.92–0.99), with an overall agreement of 0.98 (0.96–0.99). The VIASURE kit correctly detected 293/300 specimens, yielding a sensitivity of 0.95 (0.92–0.99), specificity of 1.00 (0.98–1.00), Cohen’s Kappa coefficient of 0.95 (95% CI: 0.92–0.99 and an overall agreement of 0.98 (0.95–0.99). The Singuway kit showed the highest concordance with the reference method, correctly classifying 295/300 samples and presenting a sensitivity of 0.97 (0.94–1.00), specificity of 1.00 (0.98–1.00), Cohen’s Kappa coefficient of 0.97 (95% CI: 0.94–1.00), with an overall agreement of 0.98 (0.97–1.00). This study demonstrates a good sensitivity and specificity, and strong overall agreement among the three commercial kits compared to the WHO protocol. Nevertheless, further analysis using unbiased clinical sample sets that reflect the true prevalence of MPXV-positive samples is needed for a real-world clinical performance evaluation.

papers.abstract_zh: 猴痘病毒(MPXV)是一种包膜的双链DNA病毒,属于正痘病毒属,隶属于痘病毒科。它引起一种人畜共患疾病,通过直接接触感染动物或人类,以及接触受污染材料而传播给人类。本研究的目的是对三种商业化的实时PCR(qPCR)试剂盒在富集的人工平衡样本集上进行回顾性、比较性诊断评估,样本集中包括50%的MPXV阳性样本。世界卫生组织(WHO)参考分子协议被用作参考比较标准。本分析使用了300份临床标本,其中150份为MPXV阳性(265份皮肤病变/水疱拭子和35份血清样本)。Bioperfectus试剂盒正确识别了294/300样本,显示敏感性为0.96(95% CI:0.93–0.99),特异性为1.00(0.98–1.00),Cohen’s Kappa系数为0.96(95% CI:0.92–0.99),总体一致性为0.98(0.96–0.99)。VIASURE试剂盒正确检测了293/300样本,敏感性为0.95(0.92–0.99),特异性为1.00(0.98–1.00),Cohen’s Kappa系数为0.95(95% CI:0.92–0.99),总体一致性为0.98(0.95–0.99)。Singuway试剂盒与参考方法的一致性最高,正确分类了295/300样本,敏感性为0.97(0.94–1.00),特异性为1.00(0.98–1.00),Cohen’s Kappa系数为0.97(95% CI:0.94–1.00),总体一致性为0.98(0.97–1.00)。本研究表明,三种商业试剂盒与WHO协议相比具有良好的敏感性和特异性,以及强大的总体一致性。然而,为了进行真实世界的临床性能评估,还需要使用反映MPXV阳性样本真实情况的无偏倚临床样本集进行进一步分析。

analysis_zh.main_results: Bioperfectus、VIASURE和Singuway试剂盒均表现出高敏感性和高特异性,其中Singuway试剂盒与WHO协议相比总体一致性最高,达到0.98(95% CI:0.97–1.00)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究显示,三种商业qPCR试剂盒在诊断猴痘病毒方面表现良好,其中Singuway试剂盒与参考方法表现出最高的一致性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,这些qPCR试剂盒可用于准确检测猴痘,这对于人兽共患病的监测和管理具有重要意义。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用了富集样本集,需要进一步使用无偏临床样本进行评估,以确定这些试剂盒在真实世界中的性能。

papers.title: Prediction of Monkeypox Disease and Severity of the Disease Using Machine Learning Algorithms
papers.abstract: This study highlights the growing use of machine learning (ML) over traditional statistical models in detecting and treating infectious diseases [ 1 ]. ML methods like CNNs and NLP are used for skin lesions and social media analysis [ 2 ]. Traditional models like regression and Naive Bayes are used for disease pattern recognition and case forecasting. Hybrid models like HMD and GRA-TLA improve prediction accuracy. The study also discusses challenges and presents boosting-based classification models for early disease detection and management [ 3 ].

papers.title_zh: 使用机器学习算法预测猴痘疾病及其严重程度
papers.source_body_en: This study highlights the growing use of machine learning (ML) over traditional statistical models in detecting and treating infectious diseases [ 1 ]. ML methods like CNNs and NLP are used for skin lesions and social media analysis [ 2 ]. Traditional models like regression and Naive Bayes are used for disease pattern recognition and case forecasting. Hybrid models like HMD and GRA-TLA improve prediction accuracy. The study also discusses challenges and presents boosting-based classification models for early disease detection and management [ 3 ].
