papers.full_text: Disclaimer: Early release articles are not considered as final versions. Any changes will be reflected in the online version in the month the article is officially released. Volume 32, Supplement –Summer 2026 SUPPLEMENT ISSUE Supplement Monkeypox Virus Surveillance in Wastewater, North Carolina, USA, October 2023–May 2025 Cite This Article Citation for Media Abstract In September 2023, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services identified a new case of mpox clade II 5 months after the last previous report. To assess possible unrecognized transmission, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at select wastewater sites. During October 29, 2023–May 2025, a total of 801 samples were collected across 16 treatment plants serving ≈2 million residents. We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Overall sensitivity of identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%); specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%), positive predictive value was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%), and negative predictive value was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%–85.7%). Restricting detections above the limit of detection reduced sensitivity but increased specificity. Overall, wastewater surveillance showed low sensitivity but provided complementary awareness for public health response. Since the first case was identified in a nonendemic region, mpox has emerged as an increasing public health concern in the United States. The global outbreak in 2022 affected 75 countries and territories; >2,300 cases had been confirmed in the United States by July 2022 (1). Because of evolving transmission dynamics, severity, and uncertainty surrounding social and economic impacts, the World Health Organization declared mpox a public health emergency of international concern on July 23, 2022 (2–3). Mpox is an infectious disease endemic to regions of Central and West Africa. It is caused by the enveloped DNA virus monkeypox virus (MPXV) and is characterized by fever, headache, myalgia, lymphadenopathy, and a vesiculopustular rash that can involve the face, extremities, and genital region (3). Mpox is primarily transmitted through direct contact with active lesions, contaminated materials, bodily fluids, or respiratory transmission at close range (4,5). Mpox infections are categorized into 2 genetically distinct clades, clade I and clade II. Clade II infections, which were responsible for the global outbreak that began in 2022, are generally associated with less severe disease and reduced transmissibility (5). Historically, clade I mpox infections have demonstrated greater virulence, mortality, and transmission (6). The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) National Wastewater Surveillance System initiated wastewater testing for MPXV in October 2022, five months after the mpox outbreak began in the United States. For underreported and stigmatized infections such as mpox, traditional case-based surveillance can present challenges, including incomplete capture of subclinical or unreported cases, making wastewater surveillance a valuable complementary approach to clinical mpox surveillance (5,6). Early work demonstrated that viral shedding through urine, feces, respiratory secretions, and skin lesions can result in detectable MPXV in wastewater, supporting wastewater-based epidemiology as a viable approach for monitoring and quantifying community transmission (2,7,8). In 1 study, MPXV detections in wastewater were shown to precede the identification of the clinical cases, highlighting its potential for early outbreak detection (9). Another study reported increases in wastewater viral concentrations ahead of reported clinical cases (5). Studies have also documented correlations between wastewater MPXV concentrations and incident mpox cases within corresponding sewersheds, supporting the utility of wastewater surveillance as a proxy for community-level transmission (10). Finally, wastewater detections in areas without corresponding clinical reports may help identify communities where mpox transmission might otherwise remain undetected because of social stigma, limited clinical recognition, or constrained diagnostic capacity (5,9). Recognizing wastewater surveillance as a valuable strategy for early identification of infectious disease activity, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (NCDHHS) integrated mpox monitoring into its statewide wastewater surveillance program. In September 2023, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at selected wastewater surveillance sites across the state. That assay detects orthopoxviruses including vaccinia, cowpox, and all clades of MPXV. Primary sites were facilities in Asheville, Charlotte, Greensboro, Greenville, and Raleigh; additional periodic testing was conducted at selected sites in Cary, Chapel Hill, North Durham, and South Durham. To evaluate mpox wastewater surveillance program in North Carolina, we conducted this study to estimate sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV) relative to confirmed clinical cases. Study Area and Surveillance Period We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance analysis to evaluate wastewater surveillance for detecting MPXV circulation in North Carolina. For the period October 29, 2023–May 31, 2025, we compared wastewater detections from the North Carolina Wastewater Monitoring Network, operated by the NCDHHS, with confirmed clinical mpox cases using a +17-day temporal window. We assumed clinical case reporting to be complete for the purposes of this analysis. The study included data from 16 publicly owned wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) with defined catchment areas serving a combined population of 2,002,864 persons (Table 1). Facilities were in urban and semiurban regions and consisted of 4 plants in Charlotte, 3 plants each in Cary and Raleigh, and 1 plant each in Asheville, Chapel Hill, Greensboro, Greenville, North Durham, and South Durham. During the study period, 45 confirmed mpox cases occurred within the included sewersheds. We excluded sites sampled through CDC-contracted programs (Verily, https://verily.com) and WastewaterSCAN (https://www.wastewaterscan.org) because of differences in laboratory methods, assays, reporting structures, and sampling frequency. Clinical Case Data We also obtained clinical case data from NCDHHS. A confirmed mpox case was defined according to the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists case definition from 2022 (22-ID-10) as detection of nonvariola orthopoxvirus or MPXV DNA in a clinical specimen by PCR in a patient with compatible symptoms (11). We defined case date as date of symptom onset. We geocoded cases using residential address and spatially assigned them to sewersheds by using ArcGIS Pro (Esri, https://www.esri.com). Wastewater Sample Collection and Laboratory Testing. Influent wastewater was collected as 24-hour composite samples approximately 1 time/week at each WWTP except for the 3 plants in Cary and those in Chapel Hill, North Durham, and South Durham, which were only sampled selectively over the study period, generally in response to concerns about a confirmed or suspected mpox case in the general area. Samples were transported on ice and processed within 24 hours at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. We quantified MPXV DNA using the CDC Non-variola Orthopoxvirus Generic Real-Time PCR Test (12). We originally optimized the assay in a wastewater matrix by conducting a thermal gradient from 62°C–52°C to see which annealing temperature resulted in the greatest separation from positive and negative droplet clusters (Appendix Figure). We reported results as viral gene copies normalized to flow rate and population within the sewershed. We classified samples with concentrations above the assay limit of detection (LOD) as positive (n = 17). We experimentally determined the assay limit of blank (LOB) to be 0 copies/L by using methods adapted from Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute document EP17 (13). Because the LOB was 0, we theoretically estimated the assay LOD to be 500 copies/L, because Poisson distribution requires roughly 3 copies per sample to detect >1 copies with 95% probability (14,15). Using this strategy, we classified samples with concentrations from one half the LOD to the LOD as trace detections (n = 30). Overall Sensitivity, Specificity, PPV, and NPV We classified wastewater observations as positive or negative on the basis of laboratory results, as described previously. For each wastewater sample, the presence of >1 confirmed clinical case within +17 days in the same sewershed was assessed. We selected a +17-day alignment window to approximate the biologically plausible period during which MPXV might be detectable in wastewater relative to a reported clinical case. Available data suggest that viral shedding is most likely to occur at 4 to 25 days (16,17) and might begin before diagnosis. Additional delays related to seeking care, laboratory confirmation, case reporting, and wastewater sampling can create temporal offsets between infection and detection. We selected the +17-day window to balance those biological and operational considerations while minimizing misclassification. We defined diagnostic categories as follows: true positive (TP), wastewater-positive and >1 clinical case within +17 days; false positive (FP), wastewater-positive and no clinical case within +17 days; true negative (TN), wastewater-negative and no clinical case within +17 days; and false negative (FN), wastewater-negative and >1 clinical case within +17 days. We calculated sensitivity (TP/[TP + FN]), specificity (TN/[TN + FP]), PPV (TP/[TP + FP]), and NPV (TN/[TN + FN]) overall and stratified results by WWTP/sewershed catchment. We calculated 95% CIs using Wilson score intervals because several sites had small denominators and proportions near 0 or 1. The primary analysis classified both positive and trace detections as wastewater-positive (n = 47). A secondary sensitivity analysis restricted wastewater-positive observations to samples exceeding the LOD (n = 17). Because clinical case surveillance is an imperfect reference standard and does not capture all infections, TP/FP/TN/FN classifications should be interpreted as concordance with reported cases rather than true infection status. All analyses were conducted in R version 4.2.3 (The R Project for Statistical Computing, https://www.r-project.org). During October 29, 2023–May 31, 2025, a total of 801 wastewater samples were collected across 16 WWTPs serving an estimated population of ≈2 million people. Of those, 47 (5.9%) were classified as wastewater-positive (17 above the LOD and 30 trace detections) and 754 (94.1%) were wastewater-negative. During the same period, 45 confirmed mpox cases were reported that fell within sewersheds representing the WWTPs in this study. Using a +17-day temporal alignment window, we classified 15 wastewater observations as TPs, 32 as FPs, 627 as TNs, and 127 as FNs (Table 2). The overall sensitivity of wastewater detection identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned reported mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%). Specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%). The PPV was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%), and the NPV was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%–85.7%). At the WWTP sewershed level, sensitivity was highest at Charlotte WWTP 2 (25.0%) and ranged from 0% to 25.0% across sites with clinical activity (Table 3). Several sewersheds had no temporally aligned clinical cases during the surveillance period, resulting in undefined sensitivity estimates. Specificity was consistently high across sites, ranging from 71.4% to 100%. PPV varied widely by facility, ranging from <1% to 100%, reflecting differences in case occurrence and sampling frequency. NPV exceeded 69% at all sites with clinical activity and was 100% at several facilities without aligned cases. When restricting wastewater-positive observations to samples exceeding the LOD (n = 17), sensitivity decreased from 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%) to 1.4% (95% CI 0.4%–5.0%), and specificity increased from 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%) to 97.7% (95% CI 96.3%–98.6%) (Table 2). The number of FP observations decreased from 32 to 15, whereas FN observations increased from 127 to 140. PPV decreased from 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%) to 11.8% (95% CI 3.3%–34.3%), and NPV was similar (83.2% vs. 82.1%). Site-level performance patterns were unchanged. This evaluation assessed the performance of wastewater surveillance for detecting MPXV across 16 WWTPs in North Carolina during October 2023–May 2025. Using a +17-day alignment window, wastewater detection demonstrated low sensitivity for identifying temporally aligned clinical cases (10.6% overall when including trace detections and 1.4% when restricted to detections above the LOD) but high specificity (>95%) and moderate NPV of ≈83%. We selected a +17-day window to account for the expected duration of MPXV shedding and potential delays between symptom onset, clinical diagnosis, and case reporting, while also accommodating once-weekly wastewater sampling. Because wastewater represents a composite, time-integrated signal and samples are collected weekly, this window reduces misclassification that could arise from temporal offsets between individual infections and wastewater detection. Those findings compare with national estimates reported in another study (16) that observed a daily sensitivity of 13.8% for detecting >1 person shedding MPXV and a weekly sensitivity of 31.7%. The lower sensitivity observed in North Carolina likely reflects differences in analytic approach, case density, and assumptions about viral shedding. Adams et al. (16) assumed complete case ascertainment and uniform 25-day viral shedding after symptom onset of mpox, whereas our analysis relied on confirmed case onset dates and a fixed +17-day temporal alignment window. This approach likely provides a more conservative estimate of sensitivity because wastewater detections occurring outside the defined window were classified as discordant even if they reflected prolonged or presymptomatic shedding. In addition, only 45 cases were identified across a population of >2 million persons, limiting the probability that wastewater concentrations would exceed detection thresholds. Despite low sensitivity for detecting single cases, specificity was high (95%–98%), indicating that wastewater-negative observations were generally concordant with the absence of reported cases. The NPV exceeded 80% overall and was higher at several individual sites, suggesting that the absence of a wastewater detection was associated with a low likelihood of concurrent reported cases. However, the PPV was modest (31.9% in the primary analysis and 11.8% in the LOD-only analysis), reflecting that some wastewater detections occurred without temporally aligned reported cases. Such detections could represent travel-associated cases, delayed reporting, prolonged shedding, asymptomatic or subclinical infections, or infections among persons residing outside the mapped catchment area. As a consequence, wastewater detections occurring without temporally aligned reported cases should not necessarily be interpreted as analytical FPs and might indicate true but unrecognized infections, suggesting that PPV might be underestimated. Therefore, if even a subset of those observations represented true infections, the PPV of wastewater surveillance would be higher than estimated in this analysis. Of note, sensitivity increased substantially when trace detections were included, indicating that low-level signals contributed meaningfully to temporal concordance with reported cases. That finding underscores the tradeoff between sensitivity and specificity when defining wastewater-positive thresholds. Restricting classification to concentrations above the assay LOD generally increased specificity but markedly reduced sensitivity, potentially limiting early warning capacity in low-incidence settings. In North Carolina, trace detections are interpreted within a structured public health decision framework rather than as definitive evidence of transmission and might prompt notification of local health departments and wastewater partners, review of recent case activity, enhanced syndromic surveillance monitoring, and coordination regarding case investigation or specimen retesting. Those actions are consistent with our public health action decision tree for confirmed detections (Figure). Confirmed detections might also involve escalation actions such as broader public notification, targeted outreach, and intensified sampling. Several factors likely contributed to the low sensitivity observed. First, mpox incidence during the study period was low and sporadic, reducing the probability that viral shedding might be detectable within large, pooled wastewater catchments. Second, sampling occurred once per week, which might have missed transient shedding signals. Third, wastewater represents an aggregate population-level signal, and the dilution effect within large catchments (some serving >500,000 persons) might limit detection of individual infections. Fourth, alignment relied on residential address assignment; persons infected but not residing within the sewershed would reduce measured concordance. The first limitation of this study is that reported clinical cases are not a perfect standard for infection. Our intent was to quantify the extent to which wastewater detections were temporally aligned with reported clinical cases within the same sewershed, rather than to provide an estimate of the true diagnostic accuracy of wastewater surveillance for detecting infection. Volume 32, Supplement –Summer 2026 SUPPLEMENT ISSUE Supplement Monkeypox Virus Surveillance in Wastewater, North Carolina, USA, October 2023–May 2025 Cite This Article Citation for Media Abstract In September 2023, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services identified a new case of mpox clade II 5 months after the last previous report. To assess possible unrecognized transmission, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at select wastewater sites. During October 29, 2023–May 2025, a total of 801 samples were collected across 16 treatment plants serving ≈2 million residents. We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Overall sensitivity of identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%); specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%), positive predictive value was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%), and negative predictive value was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%–85.7%). Restricting detections above the limit of detection reduced sensitivity but increased specificity. Overall, wastewater surveillance showed low sensitivity but provided complementary awareness for public health response. Since the first case was identified in a nonendemic region, mpox has emerged as an increasing public health concern in the United States. The global outbreak in 2022 affected 75 countries and territories; >2,300 cases had been confirmed in the United States by July 2022 (1). Because of evolving transmission dynamics, severity, and uncertainty surrounding social and economic impacts, the World Health Organization declared mpox a public health emergency of international concern on July 23, 2022 (2–3). Mpox is an infectious disease endemic to regions of Central and West Africa. It is caused by the enveloped DNA virus monkeypox virus (MPXV) and is characterized by fever, headache, myalgia, lymphadenopathy, and a vesiculopustular rash that can involve the face, extremities, and genital region (3). Mpox is primarily transmitted through direct contact with active lesions, contaminated materials, bodily fluids, or respiratory transmission at close range (4,5). Mpox infections are categorized into 2 genetically distinct clades, clade I and clade II. Clade II infections, which were responsible for the global outbreak that began in 2022, are generally associated with less severe disease and reduced transmissibility (5). Historically, clade I mpox infections have demonstrated greater virulence, mortality, and transmission (6). The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) National Wastewater Surveillance System initiated wastewater testing for MPXV in October 2022, five months after the mpox outbreak began in the United States. For underreported and stigmatized infections such as mpox, traditional case-based surveillance can present challenges, including incomplete capture of subclinical or unreported cases, making wastewater surveillance a valuable complementary approach to clinical mpox surveillance (5,6). Early work demonstrated that viral shedding through urine, feces, respiratory secretions, and skin lesions can result in detectable MPXV in wastewater, supporting wastewater-based epidemiology as a viable approach for monitoring and quantifying community transmission (2,7,8). In 1 study, MPXV detections in wastewater were shown to precede the identification of the clinical cases, highlighting its potential for early outbreak detection (9). Another study reported increases in wastewater viral concentrations ahead of reported clinical cases (5). Studies have also documented correlations between wastewater MPXV concentrations and incident mpox cases within corresponding sewersheds, supporting the utility of wastewater surveillance as a proxy for community-level transmission (10). Finally, wastewater detections in areas without corresponding clinical reports may help identify communities where mpox transmission might otherwise remain undetected because of social stigma, limited clinical recognition, or constrained diagnostic capacity (5,9). Recognizing wastewater surveillance as a valuable strategy for early identification of infectious disease activity, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (NCDHHS) integrated mpox monitoring into its statewide wastewater surveillance program. In September 2023, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at selected wastewater surveillance sites across the state. That assay detects orthopoxviruses including vaccinia, cowpox, and all clades of MPXV. Primary sites were facilities in Asheville, Charlotte, Greensboro, Greenville, and Raleigh; additional periodic testing was conducted at selected sites in Cary, Chapel Hill, North Durham, and South Durham. To evaluate mpox wastewater surveillance program in North Carolina, we conducted this study to estimate sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV) relative to confirmed clinical cases. Study Area and Surveillance Period We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance analysis to evaluate wastewater surveillance for detecting MPXV circulation in North Carolina. For the period October 29, 2023–May 31, 2025, we compared wastewater detections from the North Carolina Wastewater Monitoring Network, operated by the NCDHHS, with confirmed clinical mpox cases using a +17-day temporal window. We assumed clinical case reporting to be complete for the purposes of this analysis. The study included data from 16 publicly owned wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) with defined catchment areas serving a combined population of 2,002,864 persons (Table 1). Facilities were in urban and semiurban regions and consisted of 4 plants in Charlotte, 3 plants each in Cary and Raleigh, and 1 plant each in Asheville, Chapel Hill, Greensboro, Greenville, North Durham, and South Durham. During the study period, 45 confirmed mpox cases occurred within the included sewersheds. We excluded sites sampled through CDC-contracted programs (Verily, https://verily.com) and WastewaterSCAN (https://www.wastewaterscan.org) because of differences in laboratory methods, assays, reporting structures, and sampling frequency. Clinical Case Data We also obtained clinical case data from NCDHHS. A confirmed mpox case was defined according to the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists case definition from 2022 (22-ID-10) as detection of nonvariola orthopoxvirus or MPXV DNA in a clinical specimen by PCR in a patient with compatible symptoms (11). We defined case date as date of symptom onset. We geocoded cases using residential address and spatially assigned them to sewersheds by using ArcGIS Pro (Esri, https://www.esri.com). Wastewater Sample Collection and Laboratory Testing. Influent wastewater was collected as 24-hour composite samples approximately 1 time/week at each WWTP except for the 3 plants in Cary and those in Chapel Hill, North Durham, and South Durham, which were only sampled selectively over the study period, generally in response to concerns about a confirmed or suspected mpox case in the general area. Samples were transported on ice and processed within 24 hours at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. We quantified MPXV DNA using the CDC Non-variola Orthopoxvirus Generic Real-Time PCR Test (12). We originally optimized the assay in a wastewater matrix by conducting a thermal gradient from 62°C–52°C to see which annealing temperature resulted in the greatest separation from positive and negative droplet clusters (Appendix Figure). analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of wastewater surveillance for detecting mpox virus in North Carolina, USA, given the increasing public health concern associated with mpox since its emergence in a nonendemic region.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted across 16 wastewater treatment plants serving approximately 2 million residents in North Carolina from October 2023 to May 2025. A total of 801 samples were collected during this period.
analysis.methods: MPXV DNA was quantified using the CDC Non-variola Orthopoxvirus Generic Real-Time PCR Test. The assay was optimized in a wastewater matrix by testing thermal gradients from 62°C to 52°C. The limit of detection (LOD) was theoretically estimated at 500 copies/L based on Poisson distribution principles. A confirmed mpox case was defined by the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists case definition from 2022.
analysis.main_results: Overall, 17 wastewater samples were classified as positive, with sensitivity decreasing from 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%) to 1.4% (95% CI 0.4%–5.0%) when restricted to concentrations above the LOD. Specificity increased from 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%) to 97.7% (95% CI 96.3%–98.6%) under the same restriction. The number of false positives decreased from 32 to 15, while false negatives increased from 127 to 140.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that wastewater-based surveillance can provide complementary awareness for public health response, but its low sensitivity for detecting single cases indicates potential limitations in early warning capacity. The study highlights the importance of considering trace detections for temporal concordance with reported cases.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results support the use of wastewater surveillance as a tool for monitoring community transmission trends of mpox virus, particularly in low-incidence settings, while emphasizing the need for complementary clinical surveillance to improve detection accuracy.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges that clinical case surveillance is an imperfect reference standard and does not capture all infections. The low sensitivity and variable positive predictive value (PPV) suggest that wastewater detections may not always reflect true infection status, and the evidence is moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the effectiveness of wastewater surveillance for detecting mpox virus in North Carolina, USA, from October 2023 to May 2025. A total of 801 samples were collected from 16 treatment plants serving 2 million residents. The CDC Non-variola Orthopoxvirus Generic Real-Time PCR Test was used to quantify MPXV DNA, with a theoretical limit of detection (LOD) of 500 copies/L. Overall, 17 samples were classified as positive, showing low sensitivity (10.6%) but high specificity (>95%). When restricted to concentrations above the LOD, sensitivity dropped to 1.4%, and specificity increased to 97.7%. The study highlights that wastewater-based detection can provide complementary awareness for public health response but may miss many cases due to low sensitivity. The findings suggest that trace detections contribute meaningfully to temporal concordance with reported cases, and the absence of wastewater detection is associated with a low likelihood of concurrent reported cases. However, the study notes that the positive predictive value (PPV) was modest, indicating that some wastewater detections may not align with reported cases and could represent true but unrecognized infections. The evidence is moderate due to the limitations of using clinical case surveillance as a reference standard.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估废水监测在北卡罗来纳州美国检测猴痘病毒(MPXV)传播的有效性,鉴于自该病毒在非流行地区出现以来,其公共卫生关注程度不断上升。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用CDC非正痘病毒通用实时PCR检测法对MPXV DNA进行定量。该检测在废水基质中进行了优化,测试了从62°C到52°C的热梯度。基于泊松分布原理,理论检测限(LOD)估计为500 copies/L。确认的猴痘病毒(MPXV)病例定义为2022年州和地方流行病学家委员会的病例定义。
analysis_zh.main_results: 总体而言,17个废水样本被归类为阳性,当限制在高于LOD的浓度时,敏感性从10.6%(95% CI 6.5%–16.7%)下降到1.4%(95% CI 0.4%–5.0%)。特异性在同一限制下从95.1%(95% CI 93.2%–96.5%)上升到97.7%(95% CI 96.3%–98.6%)。假阳性数量从32减少到15,而假阴性数量从127增加到140。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,废水为基础的监测可以为公共卫生响应提供补充信息,但其对单个病例的低敏感性表明其在早期预警能力方面可能存在局限。该研究强调了在时间上与报告病例一致时考虑微量检测的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果支持将废水监测作为监测社区猴痘病毒(MPXV)传播趋势的工具,特别是在低传播率的环境中,同时强调需要结合临床监测以提高检测准确性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究承认临床病例监测作为参考标准是不完美的,无法捕捉所有感染。低敏感性和变化的阳性预测值(PPV)表明废水检测可能并不总是反映真实的感染状态,因此证据强度中等,由于这些局限性。

papers.title: Presumed transmission of avipoxvirus to human: Case report
papers.abstract: Current cases of human monkeypox in the world have become a serious public health problem. According to the literature, avipoxvirus cannot be transmissible to human. The purpose of this study was to demonstrate that avipoxvirus transmission to human can occur in the poultry environment. In 2024, 1000 turkeys of 8 weeks old developed the cutaneous form of fowlpox. Three days after their vaccination on the farm by the veterinarian, who had abrasions on his left hand, skin lesions similar to those of smallpox and human monkeypox appeared on his respective hand. The clinical evolution of the veterinarian's hand lesions as well as tissue samples analyzed by histopathological examination and under transmission electron microscopy, were used to make the diagnosis. Over 35 days, the hand lesions progressed through the stages of papules, vesicles, pustules, ulcerations before to the crust, and desquamation. The histopathology of hand lesions samples revealed typical poxvirus changes in keratocytes and complete virus particles resembling fowlpoxvirus were observed using transmission electron microscopy. This study highlights that variola in human can be caused through compromised tegument in the presence of avipoxviruses. It is therefore critical to learn more about these enigmatic viruses, particularly their relationship with the host range.
papers.journal: Revista Científica de la Facultad de Ciencias Veterinarias

source_records.abstract: Current cases of human monkeypox in the world have become a serious public health problem. According to the literature, avipoxvirus cannot be transmissible to human. The purpose of this study was to demonstrate that avipoxvirus transmission to human can occur in the poultry environment. In 2024, 1000 turkeys of 8 weeks old developed the cutaneous form of fowlpox. Three days after their vaccination on the farm by the veterinarian, who had abrasions on his left hand, skin lesions similar to those of smallpox and human monkeypox appeared on his respective hand. The clinical evolution of the veterinarian's hand lesions as well as tissue samples analyzed by histopathological examination and under transmission electron microscopy, were used to make the diagnosis. Over 35 days, the hand lesions progressed through the stages of papules, vesicles, pustules, ulcerations before to the crust, and desquamation. The histopathology of hand lesions samples revealed typical poxvirus changes in keratocytes and complete virus particles resembling fowlpoxvirus were observed using transmission electron microscopy. This study highlights that variola in human can be caused through compromised tegument in the presence of avipoxviruses. It is therefore critical to learn more about these enigmatic viruses, particularly their relationship with the host range.

papers.title_zh: 禽痘病毒对人类的疑似传播:病例报告
papers.source_body_en: Current cases of human monkeypox in the world have become a serious public health problem. According to the literature, avipoxvirus cannot be transmissible to human. The purpose of this study was to demonstrate that avipoxvirus transmission to human can occur in the poultry environment. In 2024, 1000 turkeys of 8 weeks old developed the cutaneous form of fowlpox. Three days after their vaccination on the farm by the veterinarian, who had abrasions on his left hand, skin lesions similar to those of smallpox and human monkeypox appeared on his respective hand. The clinical evolution of the veterinarian's hand lesions as well as tissue samples analyzed by histopathological examination and under transmission electron microscopy, were used to make the diagnosis. Over 35 days, the hand lesions progressed through the stages of papules, vesicles, pustules, ulcerations before to the crust, and desquamation. The histopathology of hand lesions samples revealed typical poxvirus changes in keratocytes and complete virus particles resembling fowlpoxvirus were observed using transmission electron microscopy. This study highlights that variola in human can be caused through compromised tegument in the presence of avipoxviruses. It is therefore critical to learn more about these enigmatic viruses, particularly their relationship with the host range.
papers.abstract_zh: 目前全球范围内的人类猴痘病例已成为严重的公共卫生问题。根据文献,禽痘病毒无法传播给人类。本研究旨在证明在禽类环境中,禽痘病毒传播可能传播给人类。2024年,8周龄的1000只火鸡出现了禽痘的皮肤型病例。在兽医为这些火鸡接种禽痘病毒疫苗接种的三天后,该兽医左手出现有皮肤损伤,其双手的皮肤病变与天花和人类猴痘的病变相似。兽医手部病变的临床进化以及通过组织病理学检查和传播电子显微镜分析的组织样本,被用于做出诊断。在超过35天的时间里,手部病变经历了丘疹、水疱、脓疱、溃疡,最终形成痂皮并出现脱屑。手部病变样本的组织病理学检查显示了典型的痘病毒变化,通过传播电子显微镜观察到了与禽痘病毒相似的完整病毒颗粒。本研究强调了在存在禽痘病毒的情况下,人类可能通过受损的病毒包膜而感染天花。因此,深入了解这些神秘病毒,特别是它们与宿主范围的关系,至关重要。

papers.title: HECA-YOLOv11: A High-Accuracy Hybrid Attention Network for Real-Time Monkeypox Skin Lesion Detection with Interpretability
papers.abstract: Introduction: The global outbreak risk of monkeypox necessitates efficient diagnostic tools. Current methods are slow and struggle to differentiate similar skin lesions, while deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class classification. This study aims to develop a high-performance, real-time screening tool for early detection of monkeypox and similar conditions. Methods: This study proposes an enhanced architecture that incorporates the Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve feature selection. HECA performs Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Max Average Pooling (MAP) on input feature maps. Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The authors developed and evaluated a deep learning framework (HECA-YOLOv11) designed for real-time screening of mpox and similar skin lesions using a four-class image dataset.
analysis.methods: The proposed architecture integrates a Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11, applying Global Average Pooling and Max Average Pooling to input feature maps, and augments a dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements.
analysis.main_results: On the test set, HECA-YOLOv11 achieved 98.9% accuracy, 99% precision, 99.3% recall, and 99.1% F1-score, outperforming EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, YOLOv11s, SE-YOLOv11, and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all metrics.

Heatmap analysis via Grad-CAM confirmed lesion-focused attention, and a PyQt5 interface was developed to streamline clinical workflows. The authors argue this represents a major advancement toward reliable clinical decision support for early mpox screening and could accelerate public health responses. However, the abstract-only evidence lacks dataset size, external validation, and prospective clinical evaluation, constraining generalisability and evidence strength.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:全球 暴发 猴痘风险需要高效的诊断工具。目前的方法速度缓慢,并且难以区分相似的皮肤病变,而深度学习模型缺乏多类分类的准确性和可解释性。本研究旨在开发一种高性能、实时筛查工具,用于早期检测猴痘和类似病症。方法:本研究提出了一种增强的架构,将高效通道注意力(HECA)机制纳入 YOLOv11 中,以改进特征选择。HECA 对输入特征图执行全局平均池化 (GAP) 和最大平均池化 (MAP)。该研究利用空间变换和像素域增强,建立并增强了包含猴痘、麻疹、水痘和正常皮肤图像的四类数据集。梯度加权类激活映射 (Grad-CAM) 生成用于病变定位可视化的热图,而基于 PyQt5 的交互式诊断界面则简化了临床工作流程。结果:实验结果表明,与测试集上的现有方法(EfficientNet-v2-l、GoogLeNet、ResNet50、VGG19、MobileNetv2、DenseNet201 和 YOLOv11s)相比,所提出的模型具有优越的性能,具有增强的检测速度、准确度(98.9%)、精确度(99%)、召回率(99.3%)和 F1 分数(99.1%)。在所有评估指标中,HECA-YOLOv11 的性能均优于 SE-YOLOv11 和 ECA-YOLOv11 超过 5.1%。热图分析证实了该模型对病变区域的关注,与医学推理相一致。讨论:集成的注意力机制和可解释性技术有效地解决了自动皮肤病变检测的关键限制。高性能和低延迟标志着可靠临床决策支持的重大进步,对早期 暴发 遏制具有重要意义。结论:HECA-YOLOv11框架为早期猴痘筛查提供了高度准确和高效的工具。其标准化界面在加速公共卫生应对和改善新发传染病的全球控制方面具有巨大潜力。

papers.title: Poxvirus antigenic proteins: from fundamental biology to translational applications
papers.abstract: Abstract Poxviruses (family Poxviridae ) infect a wide range of human and animal hosts, causing diseases of substantial concern in both public health and veterinary medicine. Although smallpox was eradicated by global vaccination, the multicountry spread of mpox since 2022 and the continuing burden of capripox and parapox infections underscore the need for sustained poxvirus research and preparedness. Poxviruses have a complex virion architecture with two infectious forms, the intracellular mature virion (IMV) and extracellular enveloped virion (EEV), and large DNA genomes encoding more than 200 proteins, creating an antigenic landscape that complicates cross-genus comparison and application-oriented target prioritization. To define the biological basis for rational poxvirus antigen selection, we provide a cross-genus comparative synthesis of antigenic proteins in Orthopoxvirus , Capripoxvirus , and Parapoxvirus , integrating biological function, sequence conservation, antibody recognition, and published immunogenicity data. We delineate major antigen classes associated with IMV, EEV, and core structures and evaluate how their conserved and variable features influence immunodominance, neutralization, cross-protection, and serological discrimination. By relating these antigen-level features to translational application, this review establishes an antigen-centered framework that connects fundamental biology with practical relevance and provides a comparative basis for vaccine candidate selection, serological differentiation, and antibody-based intervention.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 痘病毒(痘病毒科)感染广泛的哺乳动物宿主,导致公共卫生和兽医医学领域广泛关注的疾病。尽管天花已被全球根除,但自2022年以来,猴痘病毒的多国传播以及牛痘病毒和副痘病毒持续感染的负担凸显了持续进行痘病毒研究和准备的必要性。痘病毒具有复杂的病毒颗粒结构,包含两种感染形式:细胞内成熟病毒(IMV)和细胞外包膜病毒(EEV),其大型DNA基因组编码超过200种蛋白,形成了复杂的抗原景观,使得跨属比较和以应用为导向的目标优先级制定变得困难。为了定义痘病毒抗原选择的生物学基础,我们提供了正痘病毒、牛痘病毒和副痘病毒抗原蛋白的跨属比较综合分析,整合了生物学功能、序列保守性、抗体识别以及已发表的免疫原性数据。我们界定了与IMV、EEV和核心结构相关的抗原类别,并评估了它们保守和变异特性如何影响免疫优势、中和作用、交叉保护和血清学区分。通过将这些抗原层面的特性与转化应用联系起来,本综述建立了一个以抗原为中心的框架,将基础生物学与实际应用联系起来,并为猴痘病毒候选疫苗的选择、血清学区分和基于抗体的干预提供了比较基础。

papers.title: Psychologically Informed Machine Learning for Health Misinformation Detection and Propagation in Online Social Networks (OSNs)
papers.abstract: Background: Health misinformation circulating through online social networks is associated with reduced adherence to public health guidance, vaccine hesitancy, and erosion of institutional trust. Many computational approaches still treat detection as text-only classification or model diffusion using network structure alone, with limited integration of psychological susceptibility and linguistic framing. Methods: This thesis develops a multi-strand framework combining machine learning, behavioural theory, network analysis, and linguistic profiling. Using Twitter datasets spanning COVID-19 and mpox, including the Monkeypox misinformation: Twitter dataset, hereafter referred to as the Monkeypox dataset, the detection strand benchmarks conventional and transformer-based baselines and then evaluates two theory-informed models: a multi-branch fusion architecture and an ELM-informed CNN–LSTM classifier. These models integrate semantic, rhetorical, stance, and TPBand ELM-informed features. The term mpox is used throughout this thesis in accordance with the World Health Organisation’s recommendation of November 2022. The former term is retained in the official title and shortened designation of the Monkeypox misinformation: Twitter dataset, as well as where it appears in original publication titles, direct quotations, file names, or variable names [314]. When engagement metadata are missing, the Cognitive Propagation Score (CPS) provides an auxiliary ranking signal for within-dataset comparison. The propagation strand develops susceptibility-aware influence measures, fits an ELM-augmented SIRMMM model with behaviour-modulated transmission, and introduces BERTopic-VP to prioritise themes using observed engagement where available and propensity-to-spread proxies otherwise. Results: Across datasets, the proposed detection models perform competitively against representative baselines and support interpretable analysis of cues associated with misinformation and elevated diffusion risk. Propagation results indicate that structural centrality does not consistently align with influence under proxy-grounded evaluation, and that behavioural covariates can shift outbreak timing and magnitude where behavioural variance is present, subject to identifiability constraints. BERTopic-VP prioritises coherent themes that are relatively rare yet highlyranked under engagement or proxy-based signals. Linguistic profiling shows that misinformation is more rhetorically marked and affectively loaded than factual content, with pandemic-specific framing differences. Conclusion: The thesis contributes a theoretically informed and empirically evaluated toolkit for health misinformation detection, characterisation, and prioritisation, supporting monitoring and risk-informed public health communication under uneven engagement availability.

Methods: This thesis develops a multi-strand framework combining machine learning, behavioural theory, network analysis, and linguistic profiling. Using Twitter datasets spanning COVID-19 and mpox, including the Monkeypox misinformation: Twitter dataset, hereafter referred to as the Monkeypox dataset, the detection strand benchmarks conventional and transformer-based baselines and then evaluates two theory-informed models: a multi-branch fusion architecture and an ELM-informed CNN–LSTM classifier. These models integrate semantic, rhetorical, stance, and TPBand ELM-informed features. The term mpox is used throughout this thesis in accordance with the World Health Organisation’s recommendation of November 2022. The former term is retained in the official title and shortened designation of the Monkeypox misinformation: Twitter dataset, as well as where it appears in original publication titles, direct quotations, file names, or variable names [314]. When engagement metadata are missing, the Cognitive Propagation Score (CPS) provides an auxiliary ranking signal for within-dataset comparison. The propagation strand develops susceptibility-aware influence measures, fits an ELM-augmented SIRMMM model with behaviour-modulated transmission, and introduces BERTopic-VP to prioritise themes using observed engagement where available and propensity-to-spread proxies otherwise. Results: Across datasets, the proposed detection models perform competitively against representative baselines and support interpretable analysis of cues associated with misinformation and elevated diffusion risk. Propagation results indicate that structural centrality does not consistently align with influence under proxy-grounded evaluation, and that behavioural covariates can shift outbreak timing and magnitude where behavioural variance is present, subject to identifiability constraints. BERTopic-VP prioritises coherent themes that are relatively rare yet highlyranked under engagement or proxy-based signals. Linguistic profiling shows that misinformation is more rhetorically marked and affectively loaded than factual content, with pandemic-specific framing differences. Conclusion: The thesis contributes a theoretically informed and empirically evaluated toolkit for health misinformation detection, characterisation, and prioritisation, supporting monitoring and risk-informed public health communication under uneven engagement availability.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the challenge of health misinformation in online social networks by developing a multi-strand framework that integrates machine learning, behavioral theory, network analysis, and linguistic profiling. The research focuses on detecting and characterizing misinformation related to mpox, using Twitter datasets spanning the COVID-19 and mpox pandemics. The detection models, which incorporate semantic, rhetorical, stance, and ELM-informed features, perform competitively against conventional and transformer-based baselines. Linguistic profiling reveals that misinformation is more rhetorically marked and affectively loaded than factual content, with distinct pandemic-specific framing differences. The propagation strand introduces susceptibility-aware influence measures and an ELM-augmented SIRMMM model with behavior-modulated transmission. The thesis contributes a theoretically informed and empirically evaluated toolkit for health misinformation detection, characterisation, and prioritisation, supporting monitoring and risk-informed public health communication under uneven engagement availability. The study highlights the importance of integrating psychological and linguistic factors into health misinformation detection, but the evidence is limited to abstract-level descriptions without detailed results or limitations.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:通过在线社交网络传播的健康错误信息与公众健康指导依从性的降低、疫苗犹豫以及机构信任的削弱相关。许多计算方法仍然将检测视为纯文本分类,或仅使用网络结构建模传播,对心理易感性和语言框架的整合有限。方法:本论文开发了一个结合机器学习、行为理论、网络分析和语言分析的多维度框架。使用涵盖 COVID-19 和 猴痘 的 Twitter 数据集,包括猴痘错误信息:Twitter 数据集,以下简称猴痘数据集,检测部分对传统和基于变压器的基线模型进行基准测试,然后评估两个基于理论的模型:多分支融合架构和基于 ELM 的 CNN–LSTM 分类器。这些模型整合了语义、修辞、立场以及 TPBand ELM 信息特征。本论文中 猴痘 一词的使用遵循世界卫生组织 2022 年 11 月的建议。该术语在猴痘错误信息:Twitter 数据集的正式标题和简写名称中保留,以及在原始出版物标题、直接引语、文件名或变量名中出现时 [314]。当参与度元数据缺失时,认知传播得分(CPS)为数据集内的比较提供辅助排序信号。传播部分开发了基于易感性的影响力度量,拟合了一个增强型 ELM 的 SIRMMM 模型,该模型结合了行为调节的 传播,并引入了 BERTopic-VP 以在有参与度数据时优先考虑观察到的主题,否则使用传播倾向代理。结果:在多个数据集上,所提出的检测模型在代表性基线模型中表现优异,并支持对与错误信息和高传播风险相关的线索进行可解释的分析。传播结果表明,在基于代理的评估中,结构中心性并不总是与影响力一致,且在存在行为差异的情况下,行为协变量可以改变 暴发 的时间与幅度,但需满足可识别性约束。BERTopic-VP 优先考虑在参与度或基于代理的信号下相对罕见但高度排名的连贯主题。语言分析表明,错误信息比事实性内容更具修辞特征和情感负荷,并且在大流行期间存在特定的框架差异。结论:本论文贡献了一个基于理论且经过实证评估的工具包,用于健康错误信息的检测、特征描述和优先级排序,支持在参与度数据不均衡的情况下进行监测和基于风险的公共卫生沟通。

papers.title: Corona-Structured Magnetic Nanozymes Enable Dual-Mode Immunochromatographic Analysis for Flexible and Ultrasensitive Detection of Emerging Viruses
papers.abstract: Abstract Real-time and highly sensitive monitoring of pathogens in environmental and host-derived samples is critical for controlling emerging and acute infectious diseases, yet remains technically challenging. Here, we report a multifunctional nanozyme-based immunochromatographic assay (ICA) that enables rapid, universal, and multiplex detection in different scenarios through visual readouts. We constructed a corona-structured magnetic nanozyme (CSMN) with a triple signal-amplification mechanism involving “magnetic enrichment-synergistic enhancement-multiple catalytic sites,” enabling efficient enrichment of trace pathogens in complex matrices and generation of dual visual outputs (colorimetric and catalytically enhanced signals) on ICA. The CSMN-based nanozyme ICA requires only 2 min of catalysis to achieve a ≥92.65-fold increase in sensitivity and a 100-fold expansion of the detection range. Based on this platform, dual-mode detection strategies were developed for SARS-CoV-2 and monkeypox virus. The direct mode enables rapid screening within 12 min, with detection limits as low as 19.4 and 22.5 pg/mL for the two targets, respectively. The enrichment mode enables ultrasensitive detection within 20 min, with detection ranges of 0.0012–1000 ng/mL and 0.0026–1000 ng/mL, respectively, while mitigating interference from the hook effect, making it suitable for detecting low-abundance targets in complex samples. The method demonstrated high accuracy and reliability across environmental and clinical samples, with a detection time approximately one-sixth that of qPCR and ELISA, indicating strong potential for infectious disease surveillance and outbreak control.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the technical challenges in real-time and highly sensitive monitoring of pathogens, particularly emerging viruses, in environmental and host-derived samples to improve control of infectious diseases.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the development and testing of a corona-structured magnetic nanozyme-based immunochromatographic assay (ICA) for detecting mpox virus and other related viruses in various samples, including environmental and clinical specimens.
analysis.methods: The method utilized a corona-structured magnetic nanozyme (CSMN) with a triple signal-amplification mechanism, enabling efficient pathogen enrichment and dual visual outputs (colorimetric and catalytic signals) on ICA. The assay was tested for accuracy and reliability across different sample types.
analysis.main_results: The CSMN-based ICA achieved a ≥92.65-fold increase in sensitivity and a 100-fold expansion of the detection range within 2 min of catalysis. Dual-mode detection strategies were developed for SARS-CoV-2 and monkeypox virus, with detection limits as low as 19.4 and 22.5 pg/mL for the two targets, respectively.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating the potential of their platform for rapid and ultrasensitive detection of emerging viruses, with the dual-mode strategy offering significant advantages over traditional methods.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that this platform could enhance infectious disease surveillance and outbreak control by enabling faster and more sensitive detection of mpox virus and other related pathogens in complex samples.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its abstract-only evidence, but the method demonstrated high accuracy and reliability, with a detection time approximately one-sixth that of qPCR and ELISA, indicating strong potential for practical application.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a corona-structured magnetic nanozyme-based immunochromatographic assay (ICA) designed for rapid, sensitive, and ultrasensitive detection of emerging viruses, including mpox virus. The platform utilizes a triple signal-amplification mechanism to enhance detection capabilities in complex samples. The method was shown to achieve a significant increase in sensitivity and detection range compared to traditional techniques, with dual-mode strategies developed for SARS-CoV-2 and monkeypox virus. The assay offers a detection time of 12 minutes for direct mode and 20 minutes for enrichment mode, with low detection limits for mpox virus. The study highlights the potential of this technology for improving infectious disease surveillance and outbreak control, though the evidence is based solely on abstract data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the technical challenges in real-time and highly sensitive monitoring of pathogens, particularly emerging viruses, in environmental and host-derived samples to improve control of infectious diseases.
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及开发和测试一种基于冠状结构磁性纳米酶的免疫层析检测方法(ICA),用于检测猴痘病毒及其他相关病毒在多种样本中的存在,包括环境样本和临床标本。
elements_zh.methods: 该方法利用了一种具有三重信号放大机制的冠状结构磁性纳米酶(CSMN),实现了病原体的有效富集,并在免疫层析试纸(ICA)上产生双可视化输出(比色信号和催化信号)。该检测方法在不同样本类型中测试了其准确性和可靠性。
elements_zh.main_results: 基于CSMN的ICA实现了在催化2分钟内灵敏度≥92.65倍的提升,并将检测范围扩展了100倍。开发了针对SARS-CoV-2和猴痘病毒的双模式检测策略,其对两个目标的检测限分别为19.4和22.5 pg/mL。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证明了其平台在快速和超灵敏检测新出现病毒方面的潜力,双模式策略相较于传统方法具有显著优势。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,该平台可以通过在复杂样本中实现更快、更灵敏的检测,增强传染病监测和暴发的控制,包括猴痘病毒及其他相关病原体。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于仅基于摘要的证据,但所展示的方法具有高准确性和可靠性,检测时间约为qPCR和ELISA的六分之一,显示出在实际应用中的强大潜力。

The Centers for Disease Control. CNA file photo Taipei, Sept. 9 (CNA) Taiwan has reported 30 confirmed mpox cases so far this year, including two new infections announced Wednesday, with imported cases doubling from a year earlier and most cases linked to unprotected sexual contact, the Centers for Disease Control (CDC) said. The two latest cases -- one locally acquired and one imported -- involved unvaccinated men who had engaged in unprotected sexual activity. As of Sept. 7, Taiwan had recorded 20 domestic and 10 imported mpox cases in 2026. All patients were men aged between 20 and 50, according to the CDC. The 10 imported cases are double the number recorded during the same period last year, with six linked to travel to Thailand, according to CDC data. CDC spokesperson Lin Ming-cheng (林明誠) told CNA that while overall mpox cases have fallen sharply since the disease was designated a Category II notifiable infectious disease in Taiwan in June 2022, imported infections now account for a growing share of the total. During the January-August period, Taiwan recorded 322 mpox cases in 2023, 59 in 2024, 32 in 2025 and 30 this year, he said. Epidemiological investigations found that most patients had engaged in unprotected sexual activity, while nearly 80 percent had not been vaccinated against mpox. The figures indicate that Taiwan's vaccination campaign has effectively curbed domestic transmission, but some unvaccinated people continue to engage in high-risk behavior while traveling overseas, Lin said. Image taken from Pixabay The newly reported domestic case involved a man in his 40s infected with the clade I, subclade Ib strain. He developed oral ulcers, fever and skin rashes in mid-August after engaging in unprotected sexual activity earlier that month and later tested positive for the virus. The imported case involved a man in his 30s infected with the clade II strain after traveling to Cambodia in mid-August, where he engaged in unprotected sexual activity. He later developed fever, chills and skin rashes before being diagnosed. Neither patient had received an mpox vaccine, the CDC said. As of the end of August, 111,908 people in Taiwan had received at least one dose of an mpox vaccine, while 80,033 had completed the recommended two-dose regimen. Another 31,875 people, or about 29 percent of first-dose recipients, have yet to receive their second dose, according to CDC statistics. Lin said two doses are about 90 percent effective at protecting against mpox, compared with roughly 40-80 percent after a single dose. Vaccination also reduces disease severity and remains the most effective protection against both clade I and clade II strains, he said. The CDC said the incubation period for mpox can be as long as 21 days and that infected people may transmit the virus one to four days before symptoms appear. People who are not eligible for the government's free vaccination program but are assessed by physicians as being at risk of exposure can receive the vaccine at their own expense at eight designated hospitals with travel clinics across Taiwan, the agency added. news.content_title: Weakened form of Mpox drove the 2022 global outbreak
news.content: The strain of Mpox behind the 2022 outbreak was a weakened form of the virus, which may have helped to spread it faster, a new study from the University of Surrey reports. The findings show that the virus acquired mutations before it spread globally. These mutations, which are absent in current circulating forms of the virus in parts of Africa, cause less severe symptoms in patients, who unknowingly may have spread the virus across borders. Mpox is a viral infection which causes flu-like symptoms and leads to the development of a blistering rash. The virus is a member of the orthopoxvirus family, which also includes smallpox, which was eliminated more than 40 years ago due to vaccination programmes. Such is the growing concern regarding Mpox, the World Health Organisation has twice issued a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), the highest alert level for an extraordinary global health event. Outbreaks of Mpox across the globe are becoming more common and continue to cause concern amongst populations in regions affected. The virus has established human-to-human transmission chains and the dangers it poses cannot be underestimated. Although a vaccine is now in existence, supply chain issues remain and it is often a logistical challenge to ensure those who are most at risk are vaccinated. The best form of defence is to arm ourselves with as much knowledge about the virus and how it is evolving." Professor Maluquer de Motes, Professor of Virology, University of Surrey During the study, led by Professor Maluquer de Motes, scientists analysed the Mpox strain (Clade IIB, lineage B.1) which infected over 100,000 people in 120 countries in 2022 and compared it to an ancestral form of the virus (Clade IIB lineage A.1) from which it derived. Scientists found that the genetic variation between the viruses was minimal, with only 46 nucleotides differing between the two out of a possible 197,000 nucleotides, resulting in the 2022 strain being less severe than lineage A.1. This strain was found to have a reduced ability to disseminate between cells and had the ability to evade the body's immune response. Further analysis found that the 2022 strain induced higher levels of the protein IFNB, a protein that acts as the body's frontline defence against viruses and showed a reduced ability to suppress signals from proteins responsible for decreasing inflammation . Examining the impact of the virus on murine models, scientists found that the 2022 strain was less aggressive to the overall health of the mice who limited virus dissemination more effectively and had an increased survival rate after exposure to this strain compared to lineage A.1. Scientists found that the mutations were not caused by virus replication errors, but by enzymes in the human body, known as APOBEC3. As the virus circulated in humans, the enzymes introduced mutations that weakened the virus. Scientists theorise that these mutations might have helped the virus spread globally, as a weakened form of the virus enabled patients to continue with everyday life, interact with others and unknowingly spread the virus. Professor Maluquer de Motes, added: "We were very fortunate that the 2022 outbreak of Mpox contained the mutated strain of the virus, which we have found is less severe than its ancestors. The quick spread of the virus across borders and amongst people exposes the dangers of Mpox and how we are not yet fully equipped to deal with another outbreak of a viral infection. "Compared to other viruses, the genetic composition of Mpox is huge. Typically having a difference of 46-nucleotides would not warrant such a change in the behaviour of a virus however this is not the case with Mpox. This shows us the complexity of this virus and that worldwide vigilance must remain." This study was published in Nature Communications. Source: Journal reference: Sumner, R. P., et al . (2026). APOBEC3-driven attenuation of the 2022 global outbreak monkeypox virus relative to its clade IIb ancestor. Nature Communications . DOI: 10.1038/s41467-026-76580-7. https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-026-76580-7

news.content_zh: 2022年暴发疫情背后的病毒株是一种减弱形式的病毒,这可能有助于其更快传播,一项来自萨里大学的新研究报道。研究结果显示,该病毒在传播到全球之前获得了突变。这些突变在非洲部分地区当前流行的病毒株中并不存在,导致患者出现较轻的症状,而患者可能在不知情的情况下将病毒传播到其他国家。猴痘是一种病毒性感染,会引起类似流感的症状,并导致水疱样皮疹的出现。该病毒属于正痘病毒病毒家族,该家族还包括天花病毒,天花病毒因疫苗接种计划而被消除超过40年。鉴于对猴痘日益增长的关注,世界卫生组织已两次发布公共卫生国际关注事件(PHEIC),这是对全球卫生突发事件的最高警戒级别。全球范围内猴痘的暴发病例正变得越来越常见,并继续引起受影响地区人群的担忧。

analysis_zh.scale_impact_and_risk: Maluquer de Motes 教授补充道:"我们非常幸运的是,2022年的暴发中包含了该病毒的突变株,我们发现这种突变株的病情比其祖先更为轻微。"
analysis_zh.response_status_and_uncertainty: 该菌株被发现具有细胞间传播能力减弱的特点,并且具备逃避机体免疫应答的能力。

news.wechat_summary_zh: 时间：2022年暴发疫情背后的猴痘毒株是一种减弱形式的病毒，这可能有助于其更快传播，这一新研究由萨里大学报告。；地点与对象：暴发在全球范围内的猴痘变得更加常见，并继续引起受影响地区人群的关注。；事件：在研究该病毒对小鼠模型的影响时，科学家发现2022株病毒对小鼠整体健康的影响较小，其病毒传播更为受限，并且与A.1系相比，暴露于该株病毒后小鼠的存活率有所提高。；影响与风险：Maluquer de Motes 教授补充道："我们非常幸运的是，2022年的暴发中包含了该病毒的突变株，我们发现这种突变株的病情比其祖先更为轻微。"；应对与不确定性：该菌株被发现具有细胞间传播能力减弱的特点，并且具备逃避机体免疫应答的能力。

news.content: Just In Pakistan Opinion World Business Sports Tech Life & Style Health Today's Paper e-paper Sun September 13, 2026 Magazines TNS Instep Money Matters YOU US Sunday September 13, 2026 Today's Paper Prayer Timing Epaper Home Just In Pakistan Opinion World Business Sports Tech Life & Style Health Magazines Instep Money Matters YOU US TNS Sindh confirms 43 mpox cases this year as another infection reported in Karachi Patient brought to SIDH after developing body rashes, PCR test confirms mpox infection, according to hospital officials Health By Shawwala Aslam September 12, 2026 Test tubes labelled "Monkeypox virus positive" are seen in this illustration taken on May 23, 2022.—Reuters Another mpox case has been confirmed in Karachi, taking Sindh’s tally of confirmed infections to 43 this year, with the latest patient a 35-year-old resident of Shah Faisal Colony, health authorities said. The patient was brought to the Sindh Infectious Diseases Hospital on Friday after developing rashes on his body, according to hospital officials. Doctors conducted an mpox test after observing the symptoms, with a PCR test subsequently confirming the infection. The patient is currently receiving treatment at the Sindh Infectious Diseases Hospital, according to the provincial health department. The latest case is the second mpox infection reported in Karachi within two days. Karachi now accounts for 15 of Sindh's 43 confirmed cases recorded this year. Sindh had reported 41 mpox cases by September 4, when health officials confirmed the infection in a 19-year-old man who was brought to the Sindh Infectious Diseases Hospital after developing rashes. His PCR test returned positive. Pakistan reported its first confirmed mpox case in April 2023 after the infection was detected in a traveller arriving from Saudi Arabia. The World Health Organisation declared the spread of mpox a public health emergency of international concern in August 2024. Health authorities confirmed the presence of the mpox clade 1b variant in Sindh and southern Punjab in April. The variant is considered more transmissible and potentially more severe than some other strains. Mpox is a viral disease that can spread through close contact with an infected person and through contaminated materials such as bedding, clothing and needles. Symptoms can include fever, chills, exhaustion, headache and muscle weakness, often followed by a painful or itchy rash and raised lesions. news.content_original: Just In Pakistan Opinion World Business Sports Tech Life & Style Health Today's Paper e-paper Sun September 13, 2026 Magazines TNS Instep Money Matters YOU US Sunday September 13, 2026 Today's Paper Prayer Timing Epaper Home Just In Pakistan Opinion World Business Sports Tech Life & Style Health Magazines Instep Money Matters YOU US TNS Sindh confirms 43 mpox cases this year as another infection reported in Karachi Patient brought to SIDH after developing body rashes, PCR test confirms mpox infection, according to hospital officials Health By Shawwala Aslam September 12, 2026 Test tubes labelled "Monkeypox virus positive" are seen in this illustration taken on May 23, 2022.—Reuters Another mpox case has been confirmed in Karachi, taking Sindh’s tally of confirmed infections to 43 this year, with the latest patient a 35-year-old resident of Shah Faisal Colony, health authorities said. The patient was brought to the Sindh Infectious Diseases Hospital on Friday after developing rashes on his body, according to hospital officials. Doctors conducted an mpox test after observing the symptoms, with a PCR test subsequently confirming the infection. The patient is currently receiving treatment at the Sindh Infectious Diseases Hospital, according to the provincial health department. The latest case is the second mpox infection reported in Karachi within two days. Karachi now accounts for 15 of Sindh's 43 confirmed cases recorded this year. Sindh had reported 41 mpox cases by September 4, when health officials confirmed the infection in a 19-year-old man who was brought to the Sindh Infectious Diseases Hospital after developing rashes. His PCR test returned positive. Pakistan reported its first confirmed mpox case in April 2023 after the infection was detected in a traveller arriving from Saudi Arabia. The World Health Organisation declared the spread of mpox a public health emergency of international concern in August 2024. Health authorities confirmed the presence of the mpox clade 1b variant in Sindh and southern Punjab in April. The variant is considered more transmissible and potentially more severe than some other strains. Mpox is a viral disease that can spread through close contact with an infected person and through contaminated materials such as bedding, clothing and needles. Symptoms can include fever, chills, exhaustion, headache and muscle weakness, often followed by a painful or itchy rash and raised lesions. news.content: Front Page Taiwan News Business Editorial & Opinion Sports World News Features Bilingual Pages Search Search All Front Page Taiwan News Business Editorial & Opinion Sports World News Features Bilingual Pages August 15, 2026 - September 13, 2026 GO Home Taiwan News Thu, Sep 10, 2026 page4 Imported mpox cases rise from last year: CDC By Lee I-chia / Staff reporter Add TT as Preferred Source The Centers for Disease Control (CDC) yesterday reported two new cases of mpox, including a locally acquired case infected with the newer Mpox Clade Ib strain. It added that mpox cases this year had reached 30, double the number for the same period last year. The two new confirmed cases include a local case and an imported case, the centers said. Centers of Disease Control Deputy Director-General Lin Ming-cheng speaks at a news conference in Taipei on Aug.18. Photo: Lin Chih-yi, Taipei Times Both cases reported having unsafe sex before the onset of symptoms and were unvaccinated against mpox, it said. The local case is a man in his 40s who began having symptoms last month, including mouth sores, a fever and rash. The imported case is a man in his 30s, who traveled to Cambodia last month and engaged in unsafe sexual activity, and later experienced fever, chills and rash, it said. CDC Deputy Director-General Lin Ming-cheng (林明誠) said that as of Monday, 30 cases of mpox have been reported this year — 20 locally acquired and 10 imported — all men aged between 20 and 60. While the number of local cases has been declining, the percentage of imported cases has increased, he said, adding that the 10 imported cases reported this year were double the figure for the same period last year. The risk of contracting mpox overseas cannot be overlooked, he said. Of the 10 imported cases this year, six were from Thailand, and one each from Vietnam, India, Hong Kong and Cambodia, the CDC said. Epidemiological data from other countries show that both Clade II and the newer Clade Ib virus strains of mpox might cause symptoms including fever, swollen lymph nodes and rash or blisters, but systemic rashes are more widely distributed over the body in Clade Ib, Lin said. Clade Ib can spread more readily through household contacts compared with Clade II, and immunocompromised people, young children, pregnant women, or those with chronic illnesses are more likely to experience severe illness, he said. The overall symptoms and fatality rates of Clade Ib and Clade II are similar, and the severity of mpox infection depends heavily on the status of a person’s immune system, the CDC said. Mpox vaccines can provide effective protection against Clade Ib infection, and the antiviral drug Tecovirimat can help treat a severe Clade Ib infection, it added. Getting the first dose of the standard two-dose mpox vaccine regimen only provides about 40 to 80 percent protection, while completing the full two-dose series can increase effectiveness up to 90 percent, Lin said. Since the mpox vaccine was introduced in Taiwan, 111,908 people have received the first dose, while 80,033 people completed two doses, he said, adding that the CDC strongly urges the roughly 29 percent who did not get their second dose to get fully vaccinated as soon as possible. Two single-seat jets, bearing serial No. 6727 and 6728, were spotted taking off from Hickam Field in Hawaii yesterday, observers said. Based on the precedent set during the delivery of Taiwan's older F-16 Block 20s, the new Taiwan’s defense efforts sending signal to US, not China, security expert says 2026-09-10 Taiwan’s growing defense preparations might be sending a stronger signal to the US than to Beijing, highlighting the need for Taipei to tailor its deterrence efforts to different audiences, a US security academic said yesterday. Stanford University Freeman Spogli Institute for International Studies fellow Oriana Skylar Mastro made the comment during a Taipei Security Dialogue panel examining lessons Taiwan could draw from the wars in Ukraine and the Middle East. Mastro said she was impressed by Taiwan’s increased defense spending, emphasis on asymmetric capabilities and efforts to prepare society for conflict, but questioned whom those initiatives were influencing. news.content: Menu Menu Home Business Politics Nigeria International 2Open submenu Health & Wellbeing Education Life & Style Sport Editorial Backpage Close submenuInternational Africa Rest of the World Sunday, 13th September, 2026 Home Business Politics Nigeria International Africa Rest of the World Health & Wellbeing Education Life & Style Sport Editorial Backpage Search for: Breaking News INEC Publishes Final List of Presidential, N’Assembly Candidates 1 day ago Breaking: Bamanga Tukur is Dead 1 day ago Dangote Refinery Cuts Debt by N798bn to N7.9 Trillion in First Half of 2026 4 days ago Oyetola, APM Terminals Sign MoU to Develop Badagry Deep-Seaport 4 days ago Latest Headlines NTF to Train Officials Ahead of MOB National Taekwondo Championship Four Rescued, One Feared Dead As Uncompleted Building Collapses in Enugu Tinubu Arrives Paris In Continuation Of His Three-Week Working Leave Dignitaries Storm Yola as Bamanga Tukur, Former PDP Chairman, Is Laid to Rest Global Initiative Targets Wider Access to Mpox Vaccines in Outbreak Response Nigeria | 2 weeks ago Shares Share Post Email Share Share Ayodeji Ake A new global initiative has been launched to improve access to mpox vaccines and ensure that countries affected by outbreaks can receive vaccines more quickly and equitably when they are needed. Vaccines& Immunizations The initiative builds on the work of the World Health Organisation (WHO) and its partners to strengthen international coordination of vaccine supplies and improve preparedness for mpox outbreaks, particularly in countries with limited access to vaccines. At the centre of the initiative is the International Coordinating Group on Vaccine Provision (ICG), a mechanism established in 1997 following major meningitis outbreaks in Africa. ICG was created to coordinate emergency supplies of vaccines and antibiotics for countries facing major disease outbreaks. Its role is based on the recognition that although outbreaks are difficult to predict, timely vaccination can help prevent further transmission and reduce the impact of infectious diseases. Traditionally, ICG has been responsible for ensuring equitable access to licensed vaccines against cholera, meningitis, yellow fever, and Ebola virus disease during emergencies. Its responsibilities include managing global emergency vaccine stockpiles and working with partners, donors, and vaccine manufacturers to determine the size and composition of the stocks required for effective outbreak response. The expansion of the mechanism to include mpox is expected to provide a more structured approach to the distribution of mpox vaccines, particularly during emergencies when demand can rise rapidly. The move builds on measures introduced during the global mpox response. In 2024, WHO and its partners established an Access and Allocation Mechanism (AAM) specifically for mpox vaccines, treatments and diagnostic tests. AAM was designed to support the allocation of limited medical countermeasures to countries and communities where they were most urgently required. Under the new, longer-term arrangement, ICG will continue and strengthen the work initiated through the temporary mechanism. The development also follows a decision by the Gavi Board in 2025 to formally approve the establishment and financing of a global mpox vaccine stockpile under the long-standing ICG framework. Vaccines& Immunizations The stockpile is intended to ensure that vaccine supplies can be mobilised rapidly during outbreaks instead of relying solely on vaccine procurement after an emergency has already escalated. The initiative comes amid continued concern over mpox, a viral disease that can cause fever, rash, swollen lymph nodes and painful lesions. While many people recover, severe disease and death can occur, particularly among vulnerable populations. WHO has stressed the importance of vaccination as part of a broader outbreak response that also includes surveillance, testing, case management, contact tracing, infection prevention and community engagement. The global vaccine initiative is expected to complement, rather than replace, national public health measures. Health authorities and international partners will also need to address challenges around vaccine supply, financing, delivery and equitable access to ensure that the availability of a global stockpile translates into timely vaccination on the ground. The expansion of the ICG mechanism to include mpox represents a shift from short-term emergency arrangements towards a more sustainable system for vaccine preparedness. By maintaining emergency stocks and establishing clearer mechanisms for allocation, global health agencies aim to reduce delays in responding to future mpox outbreaks and ensure that countries most affected are not left behind in accessing lifesaving vaccines. analysis_zh.event: 一项全球倡议启动,旨在改善猴痘 疫苗的获取并确保暴发期间的公平分配。该倡议基于世界卫生组织(WHO)及其合作伙伴的工作,并涉及国际协调小组(ICG)。
analysis_zh.scale_impact_and_risk: 该倡议旨在加强疫苗储备的国际协调,并提高猴痘 暴发的准备能力。预计它将提供一种更结构化的疫苗分配方法,特别是在紧急情况下,并减少对未来的暴发的响应延迟。风险未明确说明,但该倡议旨在通过确保及时疫苗接种来减轻猴痘的影响。
analysis_zh.response_status_and_uncertainty: 该倡议目前处于开发和实施阶段,ICG继续并加强了通过临时接入和分配机制(AAM)启动的工作。响应正在进行中,疫苗供应、融资、交付和公平获取方面的挑战仍需解决。
